Memorandum of November 23, 2026
Expeditious Enforcement of Capital Sentences and the Pursuit of Justice for Victims of Heinous Crimes
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the laws of the United States of America, I hereby direct:
Section 1 . Background. A prolonged delay in carrying out a death sentence is a grave offense to the justice system that denies a victim's family the closure they deserve. Yet capital sentences imposed upon the most vile criminals are too often frustrated by years, or even decades, of litigation. The Department of Justice must take every step to ensure that those who commit the most heinous crimes promptly face the full consequences of their actions.
Sec. 2 . Pursuing Capital Punishment for Heinous Federal Crimes. The Attorney General, when appropriate and consistent with applicable law, shall pursue Federal jurisdiction and seek the death penalty for particularly heinous and egregious Federal capital crimes, in addition to those identified in section 3(b) of Executive Order 14164 of January 20, 2025 (Restoring the Death Penalty and Protecting Public Safety), to include:
(a) murder in the first degree of a minor;
(b) murder committed in the course of rape, sexual abuse, sexual exploitation of a child, or sex trafficking; and
(c) murder committed in the course of kidnapping or human trafficking.
Sec. 3 . Expediting the Enforcement of Capital Sentences. The Attorney General shall take all lawful and appropriate measures to ensure that federally imposed sentences of death are carried out as expeditiously as possible. These measures shall include:
(a) prioritizing the prompt resolution of direct appeals, petitions for writs of habeas corpus, and other post-conviction proceedings;
(b) opposing dilatory litigation tactics;
(c) seeking expedited judicial consideration wherever appropriate; and
(d) eliminating unnecessary administrative delays.
Sec. 4 . General Provisions. (a) Nothing in this memorandum shall be construed to impair or otherwise affect:
(i) the authority granted by law to an executive department or agency, or the head thereof; or
(ii) the functions of the Director of the Office of Management and Budget relating to budgetary, administrative, or legislative proposals.
(b) This memorandum shall be implemented consistent with applicable law and subject to the availability of appropriations.
(c) This memorandum is not intended to, and does not, create any right or benefit, substantive or procedural, enforceable at law or in equity by any party against the United States, its departments, agencies, or entities, its officers, employees, or agents, or any other person.
(d) The costs for publication of this memorandum shall be borne by the Department of Justice.
Washington, November 23, 2026

This proceeding involves efforts by the Lake Providence Port Commission (LPPC), a noncarrier political subdivision of the State of Louisiana, to acquire the portion of the McGehee-Tallulah rail corridor owned by Delta Southern Railroad, Inc. (DSRR), a Class III rail carrier, through a feeder line application under 49 U.S.C. 10907 and 49 CFR part 1151.[1] LPPC owns two other segments of the corridor (one, jointly with North Louisiana & Arkansas Railroad, Inc. (NLA)), and Southeast Arkansas Economic Development District owns a third segment. NLA holds operating authority over these three segments and has been designated by LPPC as the proposed operator of DSRR's segment if the feeder line application is granted. ( See, e.g., Am. Appl. 1, 19-20, 56, 58-59, Jan. 4, 2023.)
This decision provides notice of LPPC's amended feeder line application and adopts a procedural schedule for the submission of competing applications, comments and verified responses, and verified replies.
LPPC's initial feeder line application, which sought to acquire only part of the Line, was accepted and a procedural schedule established in early 2021. See Lake Providence Port Comm'n—Feeder Line Appl.—Line of Delta S. R.R. Located in E. Carroll & Madison Pars., La., FD 36447 (STB served Jan. 15, 2021). On August 23, 2022, the Board granted LPPC's request to file an amended application, see Lake Providence Port Comm'n—Feeder Line Appl.—Line of Delta S. R.R. Located in E. Carroll & Madison Pars., La., FD 36447 (STB served Aug. 23, 2022), which LPPC filed on January 4, 2023, seeking to acquire the entire Line. Following an unsuccessful challenge by DSRR to the completeness of the amended application and LPPC's satisfaction of certain technical requirements, see Lake Providence Port Comm'n—Feeder Line Appl.—Line of Delta S. R.R. Located in E. Carroll & Madison Pars., La. ( Nov. 2023 Decision), FD 36447, slip op. at 6-13 (STB served Nov. 20, 2023), LPPC's amended application was conditionally accepted, and LPPC was permitted to proceed with valuation discovery under the process specified in the November 2023 Decision. SeeLake Providence Port Comm'n—Feeder Line Appl.—Line of Delta S. R.R. Located in E. Carroll & Madison Pars., La. ( Dec. 2023 Decision), FD 36447, slip op. at 2 (STB served Dec. 11, 2023). In accordance with that process, LPPC notified the Board that it completed that valuation discovery on May 29, 2024, and submitted supplemental evidence regarding valuation of the Line, based on data provided by DSRR in response to LPPC's discovery requests, in July 2024.
Shortly thereafter, the Board placed this proceeding in abeyance pending resolution of state court litigation relating to LPPC's authority under Louisiana law to pursue the feeder line application. See Lake Providence Port Comm'n—Feeder Line Appl.—Line of Delta S. R.R. Located in E. Carroll & Madison Pars., La.August 2024 Decision), FD 36447 (STB served Aug. 2, 2024). In a decision served September 25, 2025, the Board, among other things, removed the proceeding from abeyance, noting that the question surrounding LPPC's authority had been resolved by the passage of new state legislation, and directed the parties to confer and submit a proposed procedural schedule by October 9, 2025. See Sep. 2025 Decision, FD 36447, slip op. at 6-8.
Thereafter, the parties submitted competing proposals for a procedural schedule, and DSRR filed a motion to strike or compel related to four of LPPC's shipper witnesses, to which LPPC and the shipper witnesses each filed a reply in opposition. In light of these unresolved issues and ongoing disputes, by decision served December 12, 2025, the Board assigned an administrative law judge (ALJ) to handle all remaining discovery matters. See Lake Providence Port Comm'n—Feeder Line Appl.—Line of Delta S. R.R. Located in E. Carroll & Madison Pars., La. ( Dec. 2025 Decision), FD 36447, slip op. at 3 (STB served Dec. 12, 2025). Between December 31, 2025, and July 2, 2026, the ALJ issued several decisions addressing discovery disputes.
By decision served May 27, 2026, the Board directed LPPC to file by June 16, 2026, any revisions to its valuation calculations and supporting evidence that LPPC believed were warranted based on the updated information DSRR provided in discovery. See Lake Providence Port Comm'n—Feeder Line Appl.—Line of Delta S. R.R. Located in E. Carroll & Madison(May 2026 Decision), FD 36447, slip op. at 2-3 (STB served May 27, 2026). The May 2026 Decision also set a deadline of July 6, 2026, for the close of discovery and stated that notice of the amended feeder line application would thereafter be published in the Federal Register and a procedural schedule set. Id. at 3. On June 16, 2026, LPPC filed and served various revisions to its valuation calculations and supporting evidence.
On July 2, 2026, the ALJ denied a DSRR motion to compel NLA to respond to certain discovery. See Lake Providence Port Comm'n—Feeder Line Appl.—Line of Delta S. R.R. Located in E. Carroll & Madison Pars., La. ( July 2026 Decision), FD 36447 (STB served July 2, 2026). On September 2, 2026, the Board denied DSRR's appeal of two aspects of the ALJ's July 2026 Decision. SeeLake Providence Port Comm'n—Feeder Line Appl.—Line of Delta S. R.R. Located in E. Carroll & Madison Pars., La. ( Sep. 2026 Decision), FD 36447, slip op. at 3-6 (STB served Sep. 2, 2026). ( printed page 76864) The Board also authorized DSRR to reopen two depositions for the limited purpose of examination pertaining to an unwritten modification agreement between LPPC and NLA. See id. at 7-8. By letter dated September 30, 2026, DSRR informed the Board that it had conducted the reopened depositions. ( See DSRR Letter, Sep. 30, 2026.) [3]
On October 30, 2026, DSRR filed a motion requesting that the Board issue a procedural schedule, along with a proposed schedule for filings. ( See DSRR Mot. for Procedural Schedule, Oct. 30, 2026.) LPPC replied to the motion on November 2, 2026. ( See LPPC Reply, Nov. 2, 2026.)
As explained in the December 2023 Decision, the Board's acceptance of the amended application was conditional to permit LPPC to seek discovery of DSRR and to file revised valuation calculations and supporting evidence. Dec. 2023 Decision, FD 36447, slip op. at 2. Discovery has been completed, and LPPC has filed its updated valuation calculations and supporting evidence. Accordingly, notice of LPPC's amended application will be published in the Federal Register .
The September 2025 Decision directed the parties to confer and submit (jointly, if possible) a proposed procedural schedule that took into account a reasonable period of time for DSRR to complete discovery and the general timeline for record-building contemplated by the Board's regulations at 49 CFR 1151.2(c), (e), and (f). Sep. 2025 Decision, FD 36447, slip op. at 8. The parties submitted separate proposals on November 19, 2025.[4] ( See DSRR Mot. for Procedural Schedule, Nov. 19, 2025; LPPC Response, Nov. 19, 2025.)
DSRR included a new proposed procedural schedule with its October 30, 2026 motion. DSRR proposes 30 days—the time period specified by 49 CFR 1151.2(c)—for the filing of competing applications. (DSRR Mot. for Procedural Schedule 3, Oct. 30, 2026.) DSRR proposes that verified statements and comments addressing both the amended application and any competing applications be due 60 days thereafter—more than the 30 days contemplated in 49 CFR 1151.2(e). (DSRR Mot. for Procedural Schedule 3, Oct. 30, 2026.) DSRR states it “expects its filing to be extensive and robust given the substantial record.” ( Id. ) DSRR also argues the record will show LPPC has failed the public convenience and necessity (PC&N) test [5] so substantially that the Board could benefit from bifurcating the PC&N analysis from consideration of the constitutional minimum value (CMV) of the Line.[6] Finally, DSRR proposes 20 days for the filing of verified replies to responses to the amended application and any competing applications. (DSRR Mot. for Procedural Schedule 3, Oct. 30, 2026.)
In reply, LPPC states that it supports issuance of a procedural schedule and responds to various assertions in DSRR's motion. ( See LPPC Reply, Nov. 2, 2026.) LPPC generally does not oppose the schedule DSRR proposes; however, LPPC requests 30 days (rather than 20) to file its verified reply, given the anticipated length of DSRR's response to the amended application. ( Id. at 3-4.) LPPC objects to DSRR's suggestion that the Board consider only whether LPPC has satisfied the PC&N test and delay determining the CMV of the Line. ( Id. at 2-3.)
DSRR's proposed schedule, modified to permit 30 days for the filing of verified replies, is reasonable and will be adopted. However, to avoid unnecessary delay, DSRR's request to bifurcate will be denied. Accordingly, all filings should address the PC&N standard, the CMV of the Line, and financial responsibility.
For the reasons discussed, DSRR's October 30, 2026 motion for issuance of a procedural schedule will be granted in part, and the following procedural schedule will be adopted for this proceeding:
Competing applications by other parties seeking to acquire all or any portion of the Line are due by December 28, 2026.
Verified statements and comments addressing the amended application and competing applications must be filed by February 25, 2027.
Verified replies by applicants and other interested parties must be filed by March 29, 2027.
1. Notice of LPPC's amended feeder line application will be published in the Federal Register .
2. DSRR's October 30, 2026 motion for issuance of a procedural schedule is granted in part, as explained above.
3. The schedule set forth above will govern this proceeding.
4. This decision is effective on its service date.
Decided: November 24, 2026.
By the Board, Anika S. Cooper, Chief Counsel, Office of Chief Counsel.
1. The McGehee-Tallulah rail corridor extends from milepost 408.9 in McGehee, Ark., where it connects with Union Pacific Railroad Company, south to milepost 498.44 in Tallulah, La., where it connects with Canadian Pacific Kansas City Limited (CPKC). DSRR owns and operates the southernmost segment of the corridor, from milepost 471.0 at Lake Providence, La., south to the connection with CPKC at milepost 498.44 in Tallulah (hereinafter, the Line).
2. A more detailed description of the procedural history and background of this proceeding is provided in the Board's decision served on September 25, 2025. See Lake Providence Port Comm'n—Feeder Line Appl.—Line of Delta S. R.R. Located in E. Carroll & Madison Pars., La. ( Sep. 2025 Decision), FD 36447, slip op. at 2-6 (STB served Sep. 25, 2025).
3. LPPC also filed a letter on September 30 noting that the reopened depositions had concluded and requesting that the Board “promptly issue a procedural schedule.” (LPCC Letter, Sep. 30, 2026.) On October 13, 2026, LPPC informed the Board, among other things, that corrected transcripts for the reopened depositions had been served on DSRR's counsel but stated it is not necessary to delay issuance of the procedural schedule to allow time for DSRR to provide those transcripts to the Board. (LPPC Letter, Oct. 13, 2026.) DSRR filed the corrected transcripts with the Board on October 22, 2026.
4. Because of a lapse in the Board's appropriation, the initial October 9, 2025 deadline for proposals was extended to November 20, 2025. See Materials Due to Be Submitted During the Fed. Gov't Shutdown, EP 751, slip op. at 1 (STB served Nov. 13, 2025).
5. Under 49 U.S.C. 10907, a financially responsible party may obtain a Board order requiring the sale of a rail line in two situations, only one of which is applicable here: when the PC&N require or permit the sale. 49 U.S.C. 10907(b)(1).
6. To be an eligible purchaser under the feeder line program, an applicant must show it is financially responsible. 49 U.S.C. 10907(b)(1)(B). To be considered financially responsible, the purchaser must be able to (1) pay the CMV for the line and (2) cover the expenses of operating on the line for at least the first three years. Id. 10907(a).

Notice, request for comments on this collection of information.
The Institute of Museum and Library Services (IMLS), as part of its continuing effort to reduce paperwork and respondent burden, conducts a pre- ( printed page 76793) clearance consultation program to provide the general public and Federal agencies with an opportunity to comment on proposed and/or continuing collections of information in accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA). The PRA ensures that data requested by the Federal Government can be provided in the desired format, reporting burden (time and financial resources) is minimized, collection instruments are clearly understood, and the impact of collection requirements on respondents can be properly assessed. This notice informs the public of the agency's intent to request renewal of the clearance for the IMLS Grants to States Five-Year State Plan Guidelines for State Library Administrative Agencies. The current five-year period covers fiscal years (FYs) 2022-2027. The upcoming five-year period will cover FYs 2028-2032, with Five-Year State Plans due to IMLS on June 30, 2027. A copy of the proposed information collection request can be obtained by contacting the individual listed below in the ADDRESSES section of this notice.
Written comments must be submitted to the office listed in the addressee section below on or before January 26, 2027.
Send comments to Sandra Narva, Lead Senior Grants Management Specialist, Office of General Counsel, ATTN: Grants Management, Institute of Museum and Library Services, 200 Constitution Ave. NW, Suite N-3629, Washington, DC 20210. Ms. Narva can be reached by telephone, 202-653-4634, or by email at snarva@imls.gov. Office hours are from 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m., E.T., Monday through Friday, except Federal holidays.
Teri DeVoe, Associate Deputy Director for Grants to States, Office of Library Services, Institute of Museum and Library Services, 200 Constitution Ave. NW, Suite N-3629, Washington, DC 20210. Ms. DeVoe can be reached by telephone at 202-653-4778, or by email at tdevoe@imls.gov. Office hours are from 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m., E.T., Monday through Friday, except Federal holidays.
IMLS is particularly interested in comments that help the agency to:
Evaluate whether the proposed collection of information is necessary for the proper performance of the functions of the agency, including whether the information will have practical utility;
Evaluate the accuracy of the agency's estimate of the burden of the proposed collection of information including the validity of the methodology and assumptions used;
Enhance the quality, utility, and clarity of the information to be collected; and
Minimize the burden of the collection of information on those who respond, including through the use of appropriate automated electronic, mechanical, or other technological collection techniques, or other forms of information technology,e.g., permitting electronic submissions of responses.
IMLS is the primary source of Federal support for the Nation's libraries and museums. The agency advances, supports, and empowers America's museums, libraries, and related organizations through grant making, research, and policy development. For more information about IMLS, visit www.imls.gov.
This action proposes clearance of the IMLS Grants to States Program Five-Year State Plan Guidelines for State Library Administrative Agencies for FYs 2028-2032.
The Grants to States program is the largest grant program administered by IMLS, providing Federal financial assistance to develop library services throughout the States, U.S. Territories, and the Freely Associated States. Title 20 of the United States Code (U.S.C.) § 9141, “Grants to States.” To receive funds under the Grants to States program, each established State Library Administrative Agency (SLAA) must submit to the Director of IMLS a Five-Year State Plan detailing certain goals, assurances, and procedures for a five-year period. 20 U.S.C. 9134(a), “State plans.” The upcoming five-year period will cover FYs 2028-2032, with Five-Year State Plans due to IMLS on June 30, 2027. The Five-Year State Plan identifies a State's library needs, sets forth the activities to be taken toward meeting the identified needs supported with the Federal funds made available under the Library Services and Technology Act (LSTA), and provides assurances that the officially designated SLAA has the fiscal and legal authority and capability to administer all aspects of an award issued under the Grants to States program. 20 U.S.C. 9122(5), “Definitions—State plan.” The Five-Year State Plan must also provide assurances for establishing the State's policies, priorities, criteria, and procedures necessary to the implementation of all programs under the LSTA. 20 U.S.C. 9122(5), “Definitions—State Plan.”
Authority for this action is provided by 20 U.S.C. 9134, “State Plans,” 20 U.S.C. 9141, “Grants to States,” and 20 U.S.C. 9103(h), “Regulatory authority.”

summary: TONY ROMM, ANA SWANSON2026年11月26日 特朗普总统将第二次依据《1974年贸易法》第301条大规模征收关税。 The New York Times 特朗普政府周三提出了一系列新关税措施，针对来自数十个国家的进口商品，其中包括中国、日本和欧盟成员国。这标志着全球贸易战再升级，尽管这场贸易战在国会和法院面临越来越多的阻力。 政府将这些关税描绘为对不公平贸易行为的回应，并指责一些最亲密的经济伙伴过度生产某些产品，冲击美国企业，并导致美国贸易逆差不断扩大。
content:
TONY ROMM, ANA SWANSON2026年11月26日
特朗普总统将第二次依据《1974年贸易法》第301条大规模征收关税。 The New York Times
特朗普政府周三提出了一系列新关税措施，针对来自数十个国家的进口商品，其中包括中国、日本和欧盟成员国。这标志着全球贸易战再升级，尽管这场贸易战在国会和法院面临越来越多的阻力。
政府将这些关税描绘为对不公平贸易行为的回应，并指责一些最亲密的经济伙伴过度生产某些产品，冲击美国企业，并导致美国贸易逆差不断扩大。
新公布的关税清单包括对部分中国进口商品征收20%的关税，特朗普政府表示，如果北京不遵守与华盛顿达成的贸易休战条款，可能将税率提高至40%。
特朗普政府还提议对欧盟27个成员国以及柬埔寨、印度、韩国、台湾和越南等其他贸易伙伴的商品征收类似的高税率，且可能进一步上调。其中一些关税也可能高达20%。与此同时，特朗普政府还单独提出了一项针对巴西的加税方案，目标是该国出口的糖和飞机。
美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔周三在接受CNBC采访时表示，在新关税生效之前，政府必须完成一系列最终监管要求，其中包括征求公众意见。他称这种做法是“具针对性的”，但指出，美国仍在与每个受影响的贸易伙伴进行磋商。
不过，格里尔表示，在许多情况下，新关税不会与特朗普政府已经实施的关税叠加征收，其中包括特朗普总统以国家安全为由对钢铁和汽车等产品征收的关税。他说，白宫也力求确保其关税措施与已经达成的贸易协议保持一致。
然而，这一系列新关税措施出台之际，特朗普正处于政治上的艰难时刻。即便最高法院今年已裁定他最初推出的针对不同国家分别征收关税的措施无效，他仍继续推行激进的贸易边缘政策。
长期以来，特朗普一直宣称，关税对于振兴国内制造业、增加财政收入以及争取更有利的贸易协议至关重要。但他反复变化的政策仍是推高消费者和企业成本的诸多因素之一，由此引发的公众不满最终导致共和党在中期选举中失去了国会两院的多数席位。
尽管如此，白宫还是冒着引发广泛反弹的风险采取了这一行动——此举可能激怒即将由民主党掌控参众两院的国会，也令华尔街感到不安，周三股市开盘后大幅下挫。与此同时，政府公布了一项关键通胀指标，数据显示10月份物价同比上涨3.8%，涨幅较9月份有所加快。
这一宣布似乎也激怒了美国最亲密的盟友和贸易伙伴。其中一些已与特朗普达成协议，以避免被征收更高的关税，还有一些仍在谈判中，而特朗普政府周三却释放出可能进一步提高关税税率的信号。
欧盟官员表示将研究特朗普政府的调查结果，但质疑欧洲是产能过剩源头的说法。欧盟发言人奥洛夫·吉尔表示，欧盟成员国希望美国“根据此次调查采取的任何措施”都能尊重布鲁塞尔与华盛顿之间的贸易协议。
按照跨大西洋贸易伙伴之间达成的协议，特朗普此次提议对欧盟征收的关税税率将定为15%。但特朗普政府同时警告，如果发现欧盟履行协议的情况“不尽如人意”，可能将税率提高至25%。
与此同时，中国官员也对白宫最新的关税行动作出了强烈回应。就在几天前，中国领导人习近平刚刚接待特朗普，举行了新一轮贸易谈判。中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆表示：“所谓‘产能过剩’是一个伪命题，中方反对以此为借口进行政治操弄。”
特朗普政府表示将根据1974年《贸易法》第301条执行新关税。该条款允许美国政府调查海外不公平贸易行为，并根据调查结果征收关税。过去，包括特朗普在内的两党总统都曾成功援引这一权力。
根据第301条，政府只有在调查并发现其他国家歧视或阻碍美国产业的证据后，才能征收关税。今年3月，为寻求恢复被最高法院裁定无效的关税措施，特朗普政府宣布启动两项此类调查。
其中一项调查针对数十个未能有效打击强迫劳动的国家。由此产生的关税于7月生效，随即遭到法律挑战。目前，这些关税正等待一个法官合议庭作出裁决，而该合议庭最近似乎倾向于作出不利于特朗普政府的裁决。
第二项调查针对特朗普政府所称的“产能过剩”问题。美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔当时表示，调查将着重了解数十个国家在多大程度上以不公平的手段扶持本国制造业、过度生产商品，从而损害美国工业的利益。
格里尔关注的是外国采取的一系列做法，包括政府补贴、货币管理、对国有企业的扶持，以及经济、劳工和环境监管政策。特朗普政府主要担心的是，这些做法使外国工业相对于美国制造商获得了不公平的竞争优势，同时加剧了美国的贸易逆差，而特朗普一直未能有效缩减这一逆差。
本月，美国政府公布的数据显示，9月份贸易逆差达到1050亿美元，较8月份略有下降，但仍是特朗普重返白宫以来第二高的水平。造成这一贸易失衡的一个重要因素是人工智能，而这恰恰是特朗普的优先事项，因为美国企业正在从海外大量采购价格高昂的半导体及其他计算机零部件。
一些企业主对新关税提出批评，称美国民众已经在为生活成本问题苦苦挣扎，而新关税可能迫使企业再次提高价格。
总部位于得克萨斯州奥斯汀的桌游发行商Fireside Games的首席执行官安妮-玛丽·德维特表示，此举“尤其令人沮丧，选民已经非常明确地表达了关税给所有美国人的生计造成的困难”。
她与一直反对特朗普贸易政策的小企业联盟“关税由我们埋单”共同提出了这一批评。针对周三公布的关税措施，德维特还说：“我们受的苦已经够多了。”
其他团体则欢迎这一举措。美国钢铁工人联合会在新闻稿中称此次打击“早该进行”，并表示近年来旷日持久的全球对话未能在钢铁、铝、化工、轮胎和船舶等一系列行业的产能过剩问题上取得进展。
“美国制造业工人受到冲击的时间已经太久了，现在我们有机会着手恢复公平的市场竞争环境，”美国钢铁工人国际联合会主席罗克珊·布朗说。
挪威和墨西哥也曾是特朗普政府的调查对象，但并未出现在周三公布的关税清单上。一名高级官员表示，针对这两个贸易伙伴的审查仍在继续。
“对美国许多企业和行业而言，全球结构性产能过剩是一个非常现实的问题，”Wiley Rein律师事务所的资深贸易律师蒂莫西·布赖特比尔说。他解释说，其他国家过度生产的商品也对全球市场造成了影响，“美国企业原本希望向这些市场出口，却因不公平竞争而无法做到”。
“量化特定行业的结构性产能过剩可能存在一定困难，但毫无疑问，这个问题确实存在，而且正在日益加剧，”布赖特比尔接着说道。

被稱為「神話之鳥」的黑嘴端鳳頭燕鷗驚現在台南北門沿海，鳥友們雀躍不已。圖／蘇佳霖拍攝、黃蜀婷提供
被譽為「神話之鳥」的黑嘴端鳳頭燕鷗驚現在台南海域；住台南北門的賞鳥與生態攝影達人蘇佳霖，今天在北門雙春海域透過鏡頭捕獲芳蹤，由於全球數量極稀少，鳥友們雀躍不已。
社團法人福爾摩沙野鳥保育協會秘書長黃蜀婷是今天接獲蘇佳霖上述喜訊，蘇大方披露所拍攝到黑嘴端鳳頭燕鷗的照片，更開心說，這次真的是「拍好拍滿」，太興奮了。
據相關文獻資料顯示，黑嘴端鳳頭燕鷗在1861 年前後被發現命名後，紀錄極少；1937年於山東青島採集標本後，長達數十年幾乎沒有確切蹤跡，一度被認為已滅絕。直到2000年由導演梁皆得在馬祖列島燕鷗保護區重新發現，震驚國際鳥類學界，此後馬祖與澎湖成為重要的繁殖棲地，據知全球數量約僅200左右。
據知，黑嘴端鳳頭燕鷗（學名：Thalasseus bernsteini，又稱中華鳳頭燕鷗）是全球極度瀕危的稀有海鳥，因長期行蹤成謎且數量稀少，它列為國際自然保護聯盟（IUCN）全球最瀕危的100個物種之一，被鳥類學者稱為「神話之鳥」。繁殖期（約春夏之際）常與大鳳頭燕鷗混群在島礁繁殖，分布於浙江沿海、台灣馬祖與澎湖、南韓等地；度冬時則會往南遷移至菲律賓、印尼等海域。
而黑嘴端鳳頭燕鷗與一般鳳頭燕鷗最明顯差異，其橘黃色嘴喙，前端約1/3為黑色，最尖端帶有一點白，體長約36至43公分，繁殖期頭頂黑色並具羽冠，背部與尾羽為灰色，額頭與腹部為白色。
黃蜀婷說，自己與社團成員今年5月與韓國野鳥協會交流時和社員拍攝到6隻黑嘴端鳳頭燕鷗，全團非常開心。這次蘇佳霖在北門雙春拍到的黑嘴端鳳頭燕鷗，還是亞成鳥，令興奮，將持續觀察是否有成鳥ㄧ起南遷過境
社團法人福爾摩沙野鳥保育協會理事長王國衍表示，若在台灣拍到繫足旗PA、PB或070上傳座標和照片至協會，第一人將致贈協會斜背包。

被譽為「神話之鳥」的黑嘴端鳳頭燕鷗驚現在台南海域；住台南北門的賞鳥與生態攝影達人蘇佳霖，今天在北門雙春海域透過鏡頭捕獲芳蹤，由於全球數量極稀少，鳥友們雀躍不已。
一隻保育類穿山甲昨晚死在台中市和平區中橫公路上，疑車輛撞擊路殺，熱心民眾保護遺體並報案，警方到場帶回遺體，通報台中市政府農業局處理。
新北市淡水動物之家有隻老犬Ada，自2015年入所一直在等待走進新家庭的機會。日前透過臺灣搖尾巴友善動物協會舉辦的老犬互動活動，終於遇見願意接納牠的陪伴家庭，適逢感恩節，新北市動保處藉此感謝長期投入動物照護的工作人員、志工及民間團體，因為不間斷的付出，才讓等待中的毛寶貝有機會迎接幸福。
台北市立動物園小貓熊家族出任務，繼6月10歲雄性「奇奇（Yaffa）」前往新加坡萬態野生動物保育集團轄下的河川生態園(River Wonders)，11歲雌性「可玥」12月1日也將啟程前往。園方說，此次交流是為建立衛星族群，維持域外保育的族群數量，進而透過動物園間交流，調度小貓熊「保育大使」前往。
屏東縣三地門鄉今年八月在安坡部落水源地附近發現台灣黑熊爪痕及排遺，本月十三日晚間在台廿四線首度目擊黑熊。三地門鄉公所昨辦黑熊保育講座，鄉長曾有欽形容族人面對黑熊的心情是「既期待又怕受傷害」，希望透過教育，人、熊共存共生。
高屏山區近日有熊出沒，屏東縣三地門鄉部落族人本月十三日開車行經台廿四線，目擊黑熊穿越馬路。廿三日晚間高雄茂林山區也有民眾拍到黑熊身影，林業保育署屏東分署近三年來首度在十天內接獲兩起黑熊目擊通報，研究團隊初判兩隻熊為不同個體，應在棲息地內移動，恰巧被人目擊。

content:
在华盛顿结束长达数月的所谓过剩生产调查后，从[中国](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/)到欧盟的主要经济体猛烈抨击[拟议的美国新关税](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261125-trump-announces-new-tariffs-eu-china-despite-us-midterms-defeat)，这可能会开启贸易的新阶段与盟友和敌人的紧张关系。

新的过路费是在[最高法院](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/supreme-court/)推翻美国总统[唐纳德·特朗普](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/donald-trump/)之前的职责几天后启动的一项调查启动的，新的过路费最高可达20%，并在生效前面临一段公众评论期，最早将于一月份生效。

阅读更多[尽管美国中期选举失败，特朗普仍宣布对欧盟和中国征收新关税](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261125-trump-announces-new-tariffs-eu-china-despite-us-midterms-defeat)

这些关税针对的是美国一些最大的贸易伙伴，其中包括中国、欧盟、印度、孟加拉国、柬埔寨、印度尼西亚、日本、韩国、马来西亚、新加坡、瑞士、台湾、泰国和越南。

Major economies from [China](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/) to the EU hit out at [proposed new US tariffs](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261125-trump-announces-new-tariffs-eu-china-despite-us-midterms-defeat) after Washington concluded its months-long probe into alleged excess production, potentially opening a new phase in trade tensions with both allies and foes alike.

Some, such as [Japan](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/japan/), denied having excessive production.

"Japan does not have any non-market policy practices or structural excess production capacity... It is regrettable that a proposed measure targeting Japan has been announced in spite of this," the country's top government spokesman Minoru Kihara said.

A senior US official, speaking on condition of anonymity, noted that the proposals sought to take existing trade deals into account.

China said ​it reserves ​the right to take necessary measures to safeguard ​its legitimate ‌rights and ⁠interests, after the United ‌States proposed new tariffs on ⁠Chinese goods based on a Section 301 investigation ​over excess capacity.

The ‌US investigation is an act of unilateralism, ‌and China firmly opposes it, ​Commerce Ministry spokesperson He Yadong said at a press briefing.

China urged the US to "correct ​it wrong practices and returnto the right track of resolving issues ⁠through dialogue and consultation," He ⁠said.

US unveils proposed tariffs on major partners, including EU and China

To display this content from YouTube, you must enable advertisement tracking and audience measurement.

One of your browser extensions seems to be blocking the video player from loading. To watch this content, you may need to disable it on this site.

 Cover image: A PROPOS © FRANCE 24

10:56

## 'Real concern'

The [European Union](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/european-union/) said it rejected the premise of new tariffs and expected the United States to stick by a deal struck last year.

"The EU and the US share a real concern about global overcapacity, much of it state-driven and concentrated in third countries. We regret the lack of joint action," [European Commission](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/european-commission/) spokesman Olof Gill said.

The EU's trade commissioner Maros Sefcovic, who also rejected the US tariff decision, said that it ‌was important Washington ​respects the 15% levy the ​bloc had ​concluded ​with the United ​States.

Watch more[EU says 'strongly' rejects premise of new US tariffs](https://www.france24.com/en/eu-says-strongly-rejects-premise-of-new-us-tariffs)

And [Singapore](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/singapore/) said on Thursday it was "very disappointed" with the proposals and denied it was protecting its domestic market or subsidising manufacturing.

[Vietnam](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/vietnam/) also faces a 20-percent tariff; [Cambodia](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/cambodia/) and [Indonesia](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/indonesia/) 18 percent; and [India](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/india/) 17 percent, according to the USTR's office.

The EU, [South Korea](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/south-korea/) and [Taiwan](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/taiwan/), which have signed trade deals with the United States, will see tariffs broadly capped at 15 percent.

In a separate announcement, the USTR also proposed additional tariffs on goods from [Brazil](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/brazil/), including aircraft, over alleged inaction on addressing US trade concerns.

The Brazilian president's office called the measures "unacceptable" and said Brasilia would "not yield to this type of threat."

Trump's tariffs have targeted Washington's friends and foes alike, and are part of a push in his second term to remake global trade by forcing countries to buy US products or produce their goods in the country.

Overcapacity concerns affect a range of sectors, from batteries to cement and chemicals to processed food, the senior US official said.

Watch more[Trump's tariffs hitting US small businesses](https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/business/20261103-trump-tariffs-hitting-small-businesses)

## 'Hollowing out'

The duties could add further pressure on US businesses already squeezed by earlier tariffs, with firms now likelier to pass on expenses to consumers already frustrated with the high cost of living.

Affordability was a key issue in this month's [US midterm elections](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/us-midterm-elections/), which saw Trump's Republican Party swept out of power in both chambers of Congress by Democrats.

The announcement came as data showed the [Federal Reserve](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/federal-reserve/)'s preferred [inflation](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/inflation/) gauge at a three-year high in October, adding to pressure to hike interest rates.

Trade lawyer Ryan Majerus said that he expected this probe to be among "the most important" actions for the Trump administration, given its underlying concern that factories with excess capacity start operations abroad and "never get turned off, even if there's no demand."

This potentially leads to an oversupply of goods, depressed prices and a "hollowing out" of US manufacturing, he added.

While the [US Supreme Court](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/us-supreme-court/) struck down Trump's global tariffs in February, his sector-specific duties remain intact.

The new levies will not stack on top of those sector-specific tariffs on items like automobiles and steel, the senior US official said.

In July, Trump imposed a separate wave of tariffs on 60 economies, accusing them of insufficient action against forced labor.

For economies facing both the forced labor and excess production tariffs, the levies would not stack up and the higher rate will prevail, the US official said.

_(FRANCE 24 with AFP)_

title: 曼谷专栏 - 东亚地缘政治格局正在悄然改变
summary: 2026年11月，从中国深圳亚太经合组织峰会的大国元首会晤，到缅甸总统首次访问越南出席多边会议，一北一南两场外交大戏登场，正推动亚太地缘政治发生一场前所未有的变局。 随着深圳亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议落幕，美中俄三国元首的历史性同台打破了冷战后大国互动的传统范式，大国领导人直接对谈显然给东亚的“中美日三角博弈“笼罩了一层阴影；另一方面，越南河内宣布缅甸总统敏昂莱（Min Aung Hlaing）将于11月28日出席湄公河次区域多边峰会，标志着缅甸军政权长达五年的
content:
2026年11月，从中国深圳亚太经合组织峰会的大国元首会晤，到缅甸总统首次访问越南出席多边会议，一北一南两场外交大戏登场，正推动亚太地缘政治发生一场前所未有的变局。

随着深圳亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议落幕，美中俄三国元首的历史性同台打破了冷战后大国互动的传统范式，大国领导人直接对谈显然给东亚的“中美日三角博弈“笼罩了一层阴影；另一方面，越南河内宣布缅甸总统敏昂莱（Min Aung Hlaing）将于11月28日出席湄公河次区域多边峰会，标志着缅甸军政权长达五年的区域外交孤立出现实质性松动，显示次区域务实性合作有意成为重塑地区秩序的主导力量。

**深圳峰会透露大国关系信号**

综合东南亚媒体报道，本月中旬在深圳举行的APEC峰会上，最瞩目的焦点莫过于美国总统特朗普（Donald Trump）与中国国家主席习近平的互动。双方不仅举行了双边会晤，更于11月19日与俄罗斯总统普京（Vladimir Putin）举行了历史性的中美俄元首峰会，三方共同发表和平宣言并就全球战略稳定展开磋商。这一幕被不少国际政治学者视为“新雅尔塔式”的交易外交预演。外界关注到特朗普重返白宫后，其外交哲学展现出极强的交易色彩，即绕开繁琐的多边同盟机制，直接与拥有绝对体量的大国首脑在谈判桌上解决眼前的经济与地缘政治危机。

然而，就中美关系而言，领导人层面的积极氛围并未完全消融二者之间的结构性坚冰。目前，中美两国正处于2025年底达成的“贸易休战”期内，而这一缓冲期将于2027年1月正式到期。就在外界期待双边经贸进一步回暖之际，北京近日仍针对美方计划加征新一轮关税的动向发出严厉警告。为避免明年年初再度陷入关税战泥潭，两国元首已定于今年12月在美国举行的二十国集团（G20）峰会上继续展开关键磋商。

另一关注热点是持续冰封的中日关系，与中美高层频繁互动形成鲜明对比，日本首相高市早苗（Sanae Takaichi）在深圳期间，未能与中国领导人习近平举行双边正式会晤。中日领导人之间零双边会晤以及稍后双方围绕“调整态度”的媒体交锋，表明短期内两国之间不具备政治破冰的互信基础。

外界纷纷观望11月中旬的深圳峰会将中日冷战彻底公开化。原因是2025年11月高市早苗将台海局势直接与“日本生存危机及军事回应”挂钩，打破了历届日本政府在涉台问题上的战略模糊空间，成为本轮中日关系全面倒退的重要导火索。北京随即将表达强烈不满的口头交涉升级成经贸与产业反制，不仅收紧赴日游客规模及暂停多项文化交流项目，今年初还锁定日本国防军工企业继续实施出口管制。此外，针对最近美日发表的联合安全声明，北京亦作出了强硬外交回应，双边关系雪上加霜。

对东京而言，比中日关系遇冷更令其寝食难安的，是华盛顿外交风向的突变。多家日本媒体表达了这种担忧，惟恐深圳开启的中美俄三方会谈平台，日后若演变为某种常设性“三大国集团”机制，华盛顿极可能在未充分协商的情况下，越过地区盟友与北京、莫斯科达成妥协，进而损害日本在亚太的核心安全利益。为了安抚亚太重要盟友，特朗普在结束访华行程后，第一时间致电高市早苗，向其通报了与习近平会谈的成果，并重申美日同盟的稳固性及共同维护印太地区开放的承诺。

尽管如此，美日之间在具体国际事务上的裂痕依然公开化，在华盛顿宣布对包括日籍院长赤根智子在内的国际刑事法院（ICC）官员实施制裁后，东京方面罕见地公开表达了反对立场。美日关系的不确定因素，令东京陷入两难：一方面不得不紧抓美日安全同盟的重要保障，另一方面却不得不警惕自己沦为华盛顿与北京谈判桌上的筹码。

**河内红毯显示缅甸外交突破**

就在东北亚因大国开展交易外交而神经紧绷之际，东南亚的政治版图也在悄然改写。越南外交部11月24日晚间发布声明，确认缅甸总统敏昂莱（Min Aung Hlaing）将于11月28日抵达河内，出席第11届“伊洛瓦底江-昭披耶河-湄公河经济合作策略”（ACMECS）峰会及第12届“柬埔寨-老挝-缅甸-越南四国合作机制”（CLMV）峰会。

众所周知，自2021年2月缅甸政治剧变以来，敏昂莱长期因东盟（ASEAN）的“非政治代表”限制措施而被排除在主要多边区域峰会之外。而此次赴越访问，敏昂莱将以文人总统身份代表缅甸执行轮值主席国责任主持ACMECS峰会。该经济战略组织由柬埔寨、老挝、缅甸、泰国和越南5个成员国组成，并有澳大利亚、中国、印度、日本、韩国、美国和新西兰等7个发展伙伴国提供外部支持。

观察发现，在敏昂莱得以踏上河内红毯，成功出席次区域多边合作机制会议的转折背后，是东盟内部“大陆派”与“海洋派”的深刻碰撞。印尼、马来西亚、新加坡等海洋国家与缅甸不接壤，因此更看重地区规范与《五点共识》的政治原则。而越、泰、老、柬四国与缅甸山水相连，缅甸战火直接外溢为邻国的现实危机。此次越南邀敏昂莱同台，既延续了平衡外交与“不干涉内政”原则，也旨在推进湄公河次区域互联互通。而东盟秘书长高金洪（Kao Kim Hourn）受邀参会，更为这场外交破局提供了背书。

敏昂莱在2025年底至2026年初的大选中胜出，于今年4月卸下国防军总司令实职，宣誓就任总统，随后通过10月的内阁重组进一步巩固了军政一体化集权。披上“民选总统”外衣后，敏昂莱密集开展周边外交，按照先双边、次区域、再东盟的路线逐步突围。

而邻国的积极回应，则源于迫在眉睫的现实利益考量。以泰国为例，自阿努廷(Anutin Charnvirakul)出任总理以来，曼谷对缅政策明显转向务实主义。长达两千多公里的泰缅边界正面临难民涌入、跨境毒品走私、妙瓦底电诈园区犯罪以及萨尔温江跨境水污染等严峻挑战。曼谷学者一针见血地指出：“你无法与空气谈判边境安全，也无法绕开实际控制内比都和边境口岸的掌权者。”老挝与柬埔寨同样出于金三角治安及防止缅甸彻底失控的考量，主张以务实接触代替外交孤立。

总体而言，近期深圳峰会的“大国三方同台”与河内峰会的“东南亚五国聚首”，预示亚太地缘政治正在进入关键的重组时期。在东北亚，特朗普的“直接谈判”策略打破了冷战后美国以同盟体系为核心的传统秩序，迫使日本、菲律宾等盟友在“被抛弃”与“被牵连”的焦虑中加速寻求战略自主。而在东南亚，面对长期僵持的缅甸危机，中南半岛国家不再等待东盟全体一致的政治共识，而是通过次区域经济合作框架，与敏昂莱政府全面恢复务实接触，从而开启了东盟内部“政治限制”与“次区域合作”双轨并行的新局面。

然而，无论是中美之间将在明年1月到期的“贸易休战”，还是缅甸国内依然激烈的武装冲突与拒绝《五点共识》的强硬立场，都在不断提醒外界，当前亚太地缘政治格局的缓和与破冰，更多是基于短期利益交换与风险管控的权宜之计。旧的秩序正在松动，而新的稳定基石，尚且远未建立。

summary: Skip to news navigation, settings and search Topic:Business, Economics and Finance Posted Thu 26 Nov 2026 at 1:46pmThu 26 Nov 2026 at 1:46pmThu 26 Nov 2026 at 1:46pm 退休人士沃尔特·林（Walter Lim）在温哥华与一名“黄乐”的模仿者合影，他在黄仁勋模仿大赛中夺冠。 (Reuters: Chris Helgr
content:
Skip to news navigation, settings and search
Topic:Business, Economics and Finance
Posted Thu 26 Nov 2026 at 1:46pmThu 26 Nov 2026 at 1:46pmThu 26 Nov 2026 at 1:46pm
退休人士沃尔特·林（Walter Lim）在温哥华与一名“黄乐”的模仿者合影，他在黄仁勋模仿大赛中夺冠。 (Reuters: Chris Helgren)
黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）和黄乐（Alice Huang）这几天突然有了几百个和他们俩“长得像的人”。
在温哥华和纽约，数百人参加模仿这两人比赛。但“看起来像什么”与“实际是什么”之间的差别，恰恰是这起英伟达丑闻的核心。
黄乐涉嫌是中国间谍，被指通过总部位于新加坡的公司Megaspeed协助将对人工智能发展至关重要的芯片转运至中国，违反了美国的出口管制规定。
据报与她有婚外情的黄仁勋已重返英伟达掌舵。美国总统特朗普表示，美国“没有理由相信”黄仁勋重返英伟达会对国家安全构成任何风险。
美国已将Megaspeed及其关联公司列入黑名单，未经特别许可，美国企业不得向其出口受管制物项。
以下是目前已知的有关Megaspeed、相关指控、芯片如何流入中国，以及中国官方媒体如何报道这起丑闻的情况。
Megaspeed是一家总部位于新加坡的云计算公司，也是英伟达丑闻的核心。
该公司主要在东南亚各地的数据中心提供计算基础设施，服务主要用于人工智能的开发和运行。
Megaspeed曾是英伟达的客户。英伟达是全球领先的美国科技公司，以设计和生产图形处理器（GPU）而闻名，其硬件和软件对人工智能发展至关重要。
英伟达的芯片被广泛用于开发人工智能模型。 (Reuters: Ann Wang)
美国一直试图限制向中国出口先进芯片，担心北京借此比美国更快地发展人工智能技术。
人工智能竞赛已经成为中美地缘政治竞争中的另一个关键议题。
这起丑闻最初于10月29日爆发。美国《纽约时报》当天援引美国情报部门消息人士报道称，黄仁勋与黄乐（二人没有亲属关系）有“亲密关系”。
报道指出，黄乐涉嫌是中国间谍，并涉嫌通过Megaspeed将先进计算机芯片输送到中国。
英国《金融时报》的报道指出，一个与黄乐有关联的复杂公司网络涉嫌协助走私英伟达芯片。
据报道，黄乐在中国数据中心行业中被称为“黄仁勋的私人助理”。 (Supplied: NetThunder/LinkedIn)
《金融时报》报道称，希望获得英伟达先进芯片的中国客户认为，设立一家离岸空壳公司可以绕过美国的出口管制。
2023年，在黄乐的领导下，Megaspeed成功让英伟达相信自己是一名符合条件的客户，并成为这家芯片制造商在东南亚最大的客户之一。
随着Megaspeed业务不断增长，黄乐与黄仁勋的关系也日益密切。
《纽约时报》援引情报来源报道称，从2025年到2026年底，黄乐一直与一名与中国国家安全部有关联的官员保持联系，时间上与她和黄仁勋的交往重叠。
Megaspeed表示，黄乐已于2025年8月离开公司，并坚持称公司的业务合法合规。
北京方面斥责“所谓‘中国间谍’的论调纯属是捕风捉影，污蔑抹黑”。
自与黄仁勋的婚外情曝光以来，黄乐一直没有公开回应，目前她人在哪里也不清楚。
Megaspeed及其关联公司已被列入美国商务部的实体清单，未经许可，美国企业不得向其出口某些技术。
这一消息于美国时间周一公布，同一天，黄仁勋在特朗普政府的支持下重返英伟达，出任首席执行官。
这些芯片被指运往中国，但目前尚不清楚通过什么方法，也不清楚数量有多少。
《金融时报》报道称，这些芯片可能通过东南亚多个国家的走私路线转运。一些媒体将这一网络称为芯片“地下世界”。
据称，芯片到达中国后，在黑市上以数倍于原价的价格出售。
《金融时报》报道称，一家与黄乐有关联的公司据称在中国境内的整个运作过程中发挥了关键作用。
新加坡总理黄循财周二表示，他不希望新加坡被企业“利用和滥用”来规避美国的出口管制。
他说：“这些芯片经由新加坡转运到其他国家……显然，我们无法调查这些国家正在发生的一切。”
尽管黄乐的名字在中国社交媒体上并未被屏蔽，但有关她涉嫌从事间谍活动的讨论却受到严格限制。
在中国受到严格审查的社交媒体上，讨论焦点集中在黄乐与黄仁勋的婚外情上。 (Reuters: Ann Wang, file photo)
一些网民分享了据称是她早年的照片，一些官方媒体账号似乎也已关闭了相关帖子的评论功能。
在小红书上，一名用户质疑有关她是间谍的说法：“如果她真的是（间谍），（政府）怎么会允许大家在互联网上讨论呢？”
黄仁勋重返英伟达，引发了中国网民一场看似庆祝的热潮。
截至周三一早，相关话题标签在微博上的阅读量超过三亿，讨论量超过10万。约300家新闻机构，包括官方媒体新华社和央视，都报道了此事。
中国社交媒体上，关于黄仁勋与黄乐之间关系的讨论相当热烈。 (RedNote and Douyin)
另一些人则不以为然。一人写道：“资本和权力的游戏而已。”另一人说，普通人只关心显卡会不会涨价。
据路透社报道，新北市一处公交车站的电子大屏幕打出这样的信息：“期待王者归来。”
中国官方媒体《环球时报》表示，“角力并未结束”，黄仁勋重返英伟达似乎并不是这场政治争论的句号，“而更像是一个新的逗号”。
《中国日报》在社论中说：“中国一贯反对通过政治化解读‘国家安全’，将半导体贸易政治化。”
中国多次驳斥所谓“中国间谍”的指控，并指责美国以此类说法为借口，限制中国获取技术。
该社论呼吁美国减少出口限制，以稳定两国关系，而不是“制造戏剧性事件，并试图利用战略性产业作为筹码”。
社论称：“人工智能代表的是一场全球性的产业变革，而不是一个私人俱乐部。最终引领这场变革的国家，未必是筑起最高围墙的那个，而是能够营造出最具创新力、最开放、最有韧性的生态系统的那个。”

报告建议对有争议的老年护理资金算法进行人工监督
报告建议对有争议的老年护理资金算法进行人工监督
发布于 2026年11月26日星期四晚上8:27 2026年11月26日星期四晚上8:27 2026年11月26日星期四晚上8:27
报告发现，临床医生应该能够推翻老年护理评估资金的算法。 （盖蒂：分辨率制作公司）
议会委员会发现，澳大利亚老年人对家庭支持服务的贡献金额应该进行审查。
工党全面的老年护理改革生效一年后，参议院家庭支持计划委员会提出了 19 项建议，包括允许临床医生推翻算法结果。
参议院调查已再延长 12 个月。
议会委员会发现，应审查澳大利亚老年人在家中接受的补贴护理的共同付款，临床医生应该能够推翻有争议的评估算法。
联邦政府老年护理改革一年后，参议院委员会建议卫生部审查澳大利亚老年人支付的家庭支持服务（例如清洁、食物准备或园艺）的金额。
议会各参议员还呼吁政府“立即”修改法律，允许人类“在评估时”推翻评估过程中使用的算法。
联盟党和包括绿党在内的中立议员一直对政府的“在家支持”计划以及用于确定某人所需资金水平以及应多快获得这笔资金的两种算法持高度批评态度。
有争议的是，这些算法不能被人类临床医生推翻，促使政府建立“升级途径”，以便处于“特殊情况”的人可以对其结果进行审查。
在坚决捍卫这些算法作为提高一致性的一种方式之后，政府还在 10 月份宣布将审查这些算法。
根据去年 11 月生效的改革，老年人必须为在家接受的非临床护理做出更多贡献。
受助者承担 5% 至 80% 的服务，具体取决于帮助类型以及他们是否是全额或部分养老金领取者。
与治疗或临时护理相比，清洁和备餐等服务需要更高的贡献。
它建议审查评估模型如何影响收入和需求不同的老年人。 （美国广播公司新闻：帕特里克·斯通）
但委员会建议卫生、残疾和老龄化部审查这一模型，以评估对不同收入和需求的老年人的影响，并确定共同支付是否“阻碍及时获得护理”。
该委员会本应提交最终报告，但现在却提出了临时报告，并将调查时间延长至明年 11 月。
在此基础上，工党参议员表示，他们不打算对临时调查结果的内容和建议发表评论。
工党参议员在补充评论中表示：“[我们]保留对委员会工作的考虑，直到委员会向参议院提交最终报告为止。”

Report recommends human oversight for controversial aged care funding algorithm - ABC News
Skip to news navigation, settings and search
Report recommends human oversight for controversial aged care funding algorithm
Report recommends human oversight for controversial aged care funding algorithm
Posted Thu 26 Nov 2026 at 8:27pmThu 26 Nov 2026 at 8:27pmThu 26 Nov 2026 at 8:27pm
Clinicians should be able to override aged care algorithms assessing funding, the report has found. (Getty: Resolution Productions)
The amount older Australia contribute to Support at Home services should be reviewed, a parliamentary committee has found.
A year after Labor's sweeping aged care changes took effect, the Senate committee into the Support at Home program has made 19 recommendations, including allowing clinicians to override algorithm outcomes.
The Senate inquiry has been extended for another 12 months.
Co-payments elderly Australians make towards the subsidised care they receive at home should be reviewed and clinicians should be able to override controversial assessment algorithms, a parliamentary committee has found.
A year on from the federal government's aged care overhaul, a Senate committee has recommended the Health Department review the amount elderly Australians pay towards their Support at Home services, such as cleaning, food preparation or gardening.
Senators from across the parliament also called on the government to "immediately" change the law to allow for humans to override "at the point of assessment" the algorithms used in the assessment process.
The Coalition and crossbenchers, including the Greens, have been highly critical of the government's Support at Home program and the two algorithms used to determine the level of funding someone requires and how quickly they should be given that money.
Controversially, the algorithms cannot be overridden by human clinicians, prompting the government to establish an "escalation pathway" so people in "exceptional circumstances" can have their outcomes reviewed.
After staunchly defending the algorithms as a way to improve consistency, the government also announced in October it would review the algorithms.
Under the changes that took effect in November last year, older people are required to contribute more to the non-clinical care they receive at home.
Recipients cover between 5 and 80 per cent of the service, depending on the type of help and whether or not they are a full or part pensioner.
Services like cleaning and meal preparation demand a higher contribution, compared to remedial or respite care.
It suggests reviewing how the assessment model impacts older older people with varying incomes and needs. (ABC News: Patrick Stone)
But the committee recommended the Department of Health, Disability and Ageing review this model to assess the impacts on older people with varying incomes and needs, and to determine if co-payments "discourage timely access to care".
The committee was supposed to deliver a final report, but has instead made an interim report and extended the inquiry until November next year.
On that basis, Labor Senators said they did not intend to comment on the content and recommendations of the interim findings.
"[We] instead reserve our consideration of the work of the committee until the time it presents its final report to the Senate," Labor Senators said in additional comments.
Coalition and Greens unite in criticising program
Inquiry Chair and Greens spokesperson for older people, Senator Penny Allman-Payne, said Labor had "botched" the Support at Home program and added "baffling layers of bureaucracy and complexity".
"Not only are providers jacking up their prices, the system rations and denies care, systematically underassessing need and priority and creating artificial scarcity by withholding packages," she said.
Shadow Aged Care Minister Anne Ruston said many of the problems were either predictable or known to the government before the changes began.
"Labor dismissed them and now a Senate committee has confirmed every word," she said.
"The committee has backed what the Coalition has said from day one: an algorithm should never have the final say over an older person's care," Senator Ruston said.
"At a bare minimum, Labor must restore human override now, and stop short-changing older Australians with 60 per cent packages while hundreds of millions of dollars sit unspent," she said.
Government faces criticism for aged care underspend
During Question Time on Thursday, Centre Alliance MP Rebekha Sharkie echoed criticism from Liberal Senator Anne Ruston earlier in the week about the government not spending its full aged care budget.
Ms Sharkie asked Aged Care Minister Sam Rae why Labor underspent by $1.4 billion last financial year.
Sam Rae says as of June 30, more than 390,000 people were on ongoing packages. (ABC News: Dane Hirst)
"Ageing Australia stated they had capacity to deliver Support at Home to 30,000 additional older Australians," Ms Sharkie said.
Mr Rae said that was a "modest" part of the overall $44 billion budget, but nonetheless it had not been spent because providers were responding slower than anticipated to the need for more at-home packages and new residential beds.
"Since the Labor government was elected in 2022, we've effectively doubled the size of the aged care budget," Mr Rae said.
As of June 30, Mr Rae said more than 390,000 people were on ongoing packages, while more than 106,000 were waiting to receive their approved level of help.
According to data from earlier this year, more than 6,400 older Australians died while in the queue for their Support at Home funding.
Despite not securing the full $3 billion of savings the government was hoping to make from private health insurance rebate changes this week, Health Minister Mark Butler said Labor would still invest that full amount into aged care.

content:
警方破获油麻地3个涉嫌犯罪窝点拘捕20人 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 26 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
警方在油麻地捣毁3个怀疑犯罪窝点拘捕20人
香港警方突击搜查油麻地三个涉嫌卖淫窝点，拘捕20人，其中包括15名外籍女子。检获了包括避孕套和毛巾在内的证据。案件将在法庭上审理。
香港警方在油麻地捣毁了三个涉嫌犯罪窝点，并在协调行动中拘捕了共20人。被拘留者包括四名当地男性、一名当地女性和15名外籍女性，年龄在20岁至57岁之间。
据警方称，两名当地男子和一名当地女子因涉嫌“经营色情窝点”而被捕。这15名外籍女性年龄介乎20至42岁，涉嫌“违反逗留条件”。另外两名当地男子因涉嫌“允许将房屋用作色情场所”而被捕。
因允许房屋用作犯罪场所而被捕的两名男子已获保释，并需要在 12 月初向警方报到。其余嫌疑人已被正式指控相关罪行。他们的案件将于11月27日上午在九龙城裁判法院审理。
在突击搜查中，警方查获了大量与非法色情活动有关的物品，包括避孕套和毛巾。

Police bust three suspected vice dens in Yau Ma Tei, arrest 20 | China Labour Bulletin Board
Thursday, 26 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Police bust three suspected vice dens in Yau Ma Tei, arrest 20
Hong Kong police raided three suspected vice dens in Yau Ma Tei, arresting 20 people including 15 foreign women. Evidence including condoms and towels was seized. Cases will be heard in court.
Hong Kong police have dismantled three suspected vice dens in Yau Ma Tei, arresting a total of 20 individuals in a coordinated operation. Those taken into custody include four local men, one local woman and 15 foreign women, aged between 20 and 57.
According to police, two local men and one local woman have been arrested on suspicion of “operating a vice den”. The 15 foreign women, aged between 20 and 42, are suspected of “breaching conditions of stay”. Two other local men were arrested on suspicion of “permitting premises to be used as a vice den”.
The two men arrested for permitting premises to be used as a vice den have been released on bail and are required to report back to police in early December. The remaining suspects have been formally charged with related offences. Their cases will be heard at the Kowloon City Magistrates’ Court on the morning of 27 November.
During the raids, officers seized a large quantity of items linked to illegal vice activities, including condoms and towels.

此次简报会面向众议院和参议院情报委员会的工作人员以及两院领导人的助手，大体概述了情报机构收集到的有关黄乐(Alice Huang)的部分信息。这名中国女子与这位英伟达首席执行官的婚外情是此次事件的核心。
美国情报官员告诉议员助手们，他们仍未完全弄清黄乐所扮演的角色。黄乐曾协助运营一家总部位于新加坡的数据中心公司Megaspeed，该公司涉嫌将先进的英伟达人工智能芯片转移到中国。
据听取了会议简报的人士称，包括来自联邦调查局、中央情报局和国家情报总监办公室官员在内的简报人员详细说明了黄乐与中国国家安全部之间的联系。情报官员告诉与会人员，没有证据表明她是受该机构指使才与黄仁勋发生婚外情的，但他们并未否认她在婚外情开始后向该机构传递了情报。
简报人员告诉国会工作人员，经常被介绍为黄乐丈夫的男子康伟是一个更重要的人物。简报人员称，他至少在某些时候曾是中国国安部的线人，并且与这家中国间谍机构有着更密切的联系。
此次简报并未包含美国收集到的有关黄乐的最敏感信息，也没有包括一份由国务卿兼国家安全顾问鲁比奥监督起草、于3月30日发布的高度机密备忘录。据知情人士透露，该备忘录描述了黄仁勋与黄乐的关系，以及黄乐与中国情报部门的关系。
据多名听取了会议情况介绍的人士称，在长达两小时的会议中，简报人员向国会高级幕僚提供了近期收集的敏感材料，以及提供给高级情报官员的信息。
《纽约时报》上个月报道称，美国政府收集到的情报显示，特朗普盟友黄仁勋与黄乐关系密切，而美国官员认为黄乐是中国情报部门的线人。
《纽约时报》周日报道称，知情人士透露，黄乐从2025年春季到今年秋季一直与中国间谍机构保持联系，这至少涵盖了她与黄仁勋保持婚外情的部分时期。《纽约时报》还报道称，康伟也与该间谍机构有联系。
上月《纽约时报》首次报道黄乐与中国情报部门的联系后不久，特朗普公开表示，他不确定黄乐是否是间谍，并宣称黄仁勋是个好人、是个天才，值得政府支持。在刚刚过去的这个周末，总统启动了一项由白宫主导的行动，旨在恢复黄仁勋作为英伟达首席执行官的职务，从而推翻了英伟达董事会迫使其辞职的决定。
该公司周一宣布黄仁勋将回归后，特朗普紧接着在社交媒体上发表声明，坚称这位英伟达首席执行官不构成安全威胁，也不是任何刑事起诉的目标。据《纽约时报》报道，尽管特朗普至少听取过两次有关黄乐与中国情报部门联系的简报（其中一次由鲁比奥进行），且司法部对芯片转移至中国的调查仍处于早期阶段，但他仍发表了上述言论。
周二为国会助手举行的闭门简报会延续了政府此前公开表现的模式，即力图将此次事件对黄仁勋和英伟达造成的损害降至最低。
周二，司法部长托德·布兰奇呼应了特朗普的声明，称没有证据表明英伟达不是“一家优秀的企业公民”，并重申没有证据表明黄仁勋有任何不当行为。
特朗普总统公开宣称，英伟达的黄仁勋既不构成国家安全威胁，也不面临刑事起诉。 John Macdougall/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images
在周二接受《纽约邮报》采访时，特朗普表示，黄仁勋没有什么可隐瞒的，在下周国会举行的听证会上，他不应援引宪法第五修正案赋予的不自证其罪的权利。当被问及是否会赦免黄仁勋时，特朗普回答说：“我想这始终是一个选项，但我认为没有必要。”
雇佣黄乐的数据中心公司Megaspeed目前正因涉嫌将先进的英伟达芯片转移至中国以规避美国出口管制而接受司法部的调查。特朗普政府周一将Megaspeed列入贸易黑名单，这意味着美国公司在未获得许可证的情况下不能向Megaspeed出口技术产品。
在周一恢复黄仁勋首席执行官职务的同时，英伟达同意设立首席合规官一职，这实际上承认了该公司需要采取更多措施来监管其芯片的最终流向。
近年来，中国最高间谍机构国家安全部将突破北京所称的美国“封锁”作为优先任务，该“封锁”限制了中国获取最先进计算机芯片的渠道。
该间谍机构一直致力于协助中国企业获取先进芯片并将其走私到中国。据美国、欧洲和亚洲的国家安全官员称，中国国安部还收集有关半导体行业及其供应链的情报。

香港票据交换所警告公众提防假冒FPS钓鱼网站 |中国劳工公告栏
星期四, 26 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港票据交换所警告公众提防假冒FPS钓鱼网站
香港银行同业结算有限公司已就一个冒充其官方网站的欺诈网站向公众发出警告。该虚假网站以提供FPS交易安全服务为幌子，诱骗用户提供个人身份证明、银行详细信息和电话号码。
香港银行同业结算有限公司（HKICL）已就一个冒充其官方网站的欺诈网站向公众发出警告。该诈骗网站托管于hksystemfps.lat，冒充“买家网上安全保证”，并声称提供FPS（快速支付系统）网上交易安全服务，包括退款、报告未经授权的网上交易和网上交易支持。
HKICL表示，该虚假网站试图以实名验证为借口，诱骗用户提供个人身份证件号码、身份证复印件和电话号码，并承诺现金奖励。该网站还试图诱导用户透露银行名称、银行账号和账户持有人姓名，以实现在平台上的虚拟钱包存取款，并进一步引导用户与假冒客服人员进行对话。
HKICL澄清，该欺诈网站与清算所或其任何业务绝对没有任何关系。一般情况下，HKICL不会直接向个人公众提供FPS服务，也不会主动联系个人。 HKICL 的正版官方网站是 www.hkicl.com.hk 和 fps.hkicl.com.hk。
HKICL 敦促公众警惕可疑电话、网站或其他通讯方式，并谨慎保护自己的个人数据。任何人如收到自称来自 HKICL 成员的可疑通讯，应致电信息交换所 2533 1111 核实其真实性。怀疑受骗的市民应立即向警方举报。

Thursday, 26 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong clearing house warns public of fake FPS phishing website
Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited has warned the public about a fraudulent website impersonating its official site. The bogus site lures users into providing personal identification, bank details and phone numbers under the guise of offering FPS transaction security services.
The Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited (HKICL) has warned the public about a fraudulent website that impersonates its official site. The scam website, hosted at hksystemfps.lat, poses as a “Buyer Online Security Guarantee” and claims to offer FPS (Faster Payment System) online transaction security services, including refunds, reporting of unauthorised online transactions and online transaction support.
The HKICL said the bogus site attempts to trick users into providing personal identity document numbers, copies of their identity cards and telephone numbers under the pretext of real-name verification, promising cash rewards. The website also tries to induce users to disclose their bank name, bank account number and the name of the account holder, with the aim of enabling deposits and withdrawals from a virtual wallet on the platform, and further directs users to engage in conversations with fake customer service personnel.
The HKICL clarified that the fraudulent website has absolutely no connection with the clearing house or any of its businesses. Under normal circumstances, the HKICL does not provide FPS services directly to individual members of the public, nor does it proactively contact individuals. The genuine official websites of the HKICL are www.hkicl.com.hk and fps.hkicl.com.hk.
The HKICL has urged the public to be wary of suspicious phone calls, websites or other communications, and to protect their personal data carefully. Anyone who receives a suspicious communication claiming to be from an HKICL member should call the clearing house at 2533 1111 to verify its authenticity. Members of the public who suspect they have been deceived should report the matter to the police immediately.

有多少国家可以说他们的国防部长主持了领先的播客？尽管世界各地的一些政治家都以嘉宾身份出现在热门节目中，但小泉进次郎一边兼顾着日本现任防卫大臣的职责，一边发布每两周一次的节目。 “小泉进次郎的播客”经常跻身日本三大政治播客之列，内容涵盖从自卫队 (SDF) 在吉布提的反海盗行动到他个人的姜猪肉食谱等方方面面。
通过这个平台和他更广泛的公众形象，小泉正逐渐揭开日本国防机构的神秘面纱，并帮助日本公众了解该国自二战以来可能最复杂的安全环境。通过这样做，他正在促进一场早该进行的、更知情的有关日本防务政策的公开对话。
小泉的播客并不是从国防问题开始的。在 2025 年 10 月之前，该计划反映了他作为日本农业大臣（或自称为“稻米大臣”）的优先事项，其任务是稳定大米价格。虽然小泉可能还不是日本经验最丰富的防务官员，但他拥有许多内阁前任所缺乏的东西：沟通天赋、英俊的外表、年轻的活力以及让人想起他父亲、前首相小泉纯一郎的超凡魅力。这些品质使他成为日本不透明的官僚机构和公众之间的主要中间人，播客提供了一种平易近人的参与媒介。
日本公众最常将自卫队与在国内外发生地震、洪水或其他灾难时出动的应急响应联系起来。他们在这一领域非常有能力，以惊人的速度和协调性运送物资并进行搜救。然而，主要从救灾的角度来看待自卫队，可能会掩盖保卫日本可能对他们提出的要求，或者公众必须权衡其能力和部署的决定。
大多数日本公众对自卫队持积极态度（93.5%），这使得舆论氛围有利于更好地理解他们的实际责任和日本不断变化的防务优先事项。小泉通过展示自卫队的各种活动，包括实弹演习、与美国和其他国家军队的联合演习，以及参与联合国维和行动，撬开了这扇门。在此过程中，他强调了自卫队人员的战略重要性和真正的牺牲。他偶尔会分享听众的留言，他们说他的播客加深了他们对自卫队的欣赏，有些人甚至报告说，这激励了他们或家人入伍。
类似的模式可能有助于提高人们对更广泛的国防问题的认识。在以中国为标志的地缘政治气候下

How many countries can say that their defense minister hosts a leading podcast? While some politicians around the world appear as guests on popular programs, Koizumi Shinjiro juggles his duties as Japan’s sitting defense minister while releasing biweekly episodes. “Shinjiro Koizumi’s Podcast,” as it is titled, regularly ranks among Japan’s top three political podcasts, covering everything from the Self-Defense Forces’ (SDF) counterpiracy operations in Djibouti to his personal ginger pork recipe.
Through this platform and his broader public persona, Koizumi is gradually demystifying Japan’s defense establishment and helping the Japanese public make sense of what may be the country’s most complex security environment since World War II. In doing so, he is fostering a long-overdue, more informed public conversation about Japan’s defense policy.
Koizumi’s podcast did not begin with defense issues. Until October 2025, the program reflected his priorities as Japan’s agriculture minister – or self-declared “rice minister” – tasked with stabilizing rice prices. While he may not yet be Japan’s most seasoned defense official, Koizumi possesses what many of his predecessors in Cabinet posts have lacked: a gift for communication, good looks, youthful energy, and a charismatic personality reminiscent of his father, former Prime Minister Koizumi Junichiro. These qualities make him a prime intermediary between Japan’s opaque bureaucracy and the public, with the podcast offering an approachable medium for engagement.
The Japanese public most commonly associates the SDF with emergency response, dispatched in the event of an earthquake, flood, or other disaster at home or abroad. They are highly competent in this arena, delivering supplies and conducting search and rescue with remarkable speed and coordination. However, viewing the SDF primarily through the lens of disaster relief risks overshadowing what defending Japan may require of them – or the decisions the public must weigh about their capabilities and deployment.
Most of the Japanese public views the SDF favorably – 93.5 percent – making the public opinion climate conducive to fostering a better understanding of their actual responsibilities and Japan’s evolving defense priorities. Koizumi has pried open that door by showcasing the SDF’s various activities, including live-fire drills, joint exercises with the United States and other militaries, and participation in United Nations peacekeeping operations. In doing so, he highlights their strategic importance and the real sacrifices made by SDF personnel. He occasionally shares messages from listeners who say his podcast has deepened their appreciation for the SDF, with some even reporting that it has inspired them or family members to enlist.
A similar pattern could help raise awareness of wider defense issues. In a geopolitical climate marked by China’s rapid military buildup, the possibility of a conflict in the Taiwan Strait, an unpredictable nuclear-armed North Korea, and growing uncertainty about the United States’ security commitment, Japan has no shortage of challenges on its doorstep.
Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae’s administration has taken meaningful steps to bolster Japan’s defenses, including a push to revise the three strategic documents – the National Security Strategy, National Defense Strategy, and Defense Buildup Program – by the end of this year. Defense spending may be hiked from just under 2 percent to 3.5 percent of GDP over the next five years, in line with updated U.S. demands of its allies. Perhaps even more stirring has been Takaichi’s suggestion that there may be “room to discuss” rewording Japan’s third non-nuclear principle of prohibiting the introduction of nuclear weapons into the country. She has also indicated that the SDF’s potential acquisition of nuclear-powered submarines was under serious consideration, a move that would challenge the current legal framework governing the peaceful use of nuclear energy.
These developments echo Koizumi’s recent calls to break the taboo on debating nuclear weapons. In a country strongly tied to its pacifist tradition, the Takaichi administration’s position departs from the general public sentiment, which firmly supports upholding the three non-nuclear principles. And while Koizumi, on his own, is unlikely to move the needle on this sensitive issue, he is perhaps the best candidate among Japan’s high-ranking officials to facilitate its public discussion.
A prerequisite to seriously broaching the nuclear weapons debate, however, is greater public awareness of the security threats Japan faces. This is also crucial if the Takaichi administration is to realize its most ambitious goal of constitutional revision, which would require not only approval by both Diet chambers but also a national referendum.
Polling shows that the Japanese public overwhelmingly sees China as the biggest national security threat. A full grasp of the security reality, however, requires not only identifying adversaries but also recognizing the importance of forging closer partnerships with like-minded neighbors like South Korea. Although relations with Seoul remain complicated by deep-rooted historical issues, Koizumi frequently shares insights from his diplomatic engagements, speaking positively about his interactions with his South Korean and other counterparts. Such glimpses may help improve public perceptions of these partners and convey their strategic value over time.
Koizumi’s podcast avoids the jargon and over-formality often found in political commentary, inviting listeners to contemplate the future of Japan’s security rather than be lectured. The sincerity with which he repeatedly expresses his appreciation for the SDF and the civil servants in his ministry has proven to resonate with listeners.
Public engagement in politics has historically been limited in Japan, and the barriers can be especially high when it comes to foreign policy issues that feel removed from citizens’ everyday lives. Yet Japan’s domestic prosperity is inextricably linked to its national security, and whether one believes the country should expand its defense capabilities or maintain the status quo, defense issues can no longer be dismissed as matters to be left to the political elite. The effectiveness of Koizumi’s messaging through his podcast and in his official communications has demonstrated that he is the right person for this moment.

2026年，美国继续发动经济攻势，寻求在非洲各地获取关键矿产，与中国争夺新技术和能源转型所必需的材料。 2027 年非洲各国政府能否兑现这些承诺？民主党控制的新一届美国国会是否会让美国交易的透明度调查变得更加复杂？ – 投资还是承诺？ – 美国公司和财团今年宣布通过在几内亚、南非、莫桑比克和肯尼亚的合作伙伴关系开展大规模矿业投资项目。但 2025 年 12 月与刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 达成的战略伙伴关系表明，华盛顿为确保关键矿产供应并减少对中国的依赖而采取了经济行动。中国已经领先很长时间了。它于 20 世纪 90 年代开始投资非洲采矿业。该协议规定，金沙萨将确定美国投资者拥有优先报价权的矿业资产组合。作为回报，刚果政府在其动荡的东部地区的安全问题上获得了华盛顿的外交支持，该地区30多年来一直受到无数武装团体暴力的影响。此后，美国Virtus Minerals公司与印度Lloyds Metals&Energy集团合作，宣布收购Cemaf，这是一家负债累累的刚果公司，专门生产铜和钴。
Orion Critical Mineral Consortium 正在与国际集团嘉能可 (Glencore) 就其 Mutanda 和 Kamoto 矿 40% 的股份进行谈判，这些矿也生产铜和钴。 – 透明度调查？ – 金沙萨本月敦促华盛顿“从签署协议转向实际投资”。但民主党在美国中期选举中的胜利可能会使特朗普政府缔结的伙伴关系的实施变得复杂，因为这些伙伴关系的透明度受到质疑。民主党已经宣​​布计划明年初对特朗普政府进行谈判的条件展开调查。刚果民主共和国的一位矿业消息人士告诉法新社：“2027 年伙伴关系原则不应发生任何变化，因为矿产供应关系到美国的战略国家利益。” “在选举前夕，该行业在这个问题上得到了两党的保证，”消息人士补充道。 “但这些协议可能会受到民主党的机会主义审查，这可能会减慢其实施速度，”消息人士称。 – 当地经济效益？ – 一些非洲国家明确表明了从伙伴关系中获取经济利益的决心。津巴布韦在 2027 年全面禁令之前于 2 月暂停了原矿出口，称需要在该国进行加工和改造。
该禁令促使矿业公司争相建设锂加工厂，这是价值链的第一步。由一家中国公司建造的第一家工厂现已投入运营。其他的正在计划中。全球领先的钴生产国刚果民主共和国已从下个月起暂停出口顶级电池所需的金属。该措施旨在通过防止市场供应过剩来支撑价格，在配额政策出台之前已于 2025 年 2 月实施。 “长期以来，我国为世界各地的工业财富做出了贡献，却没有保留足够的技术储备。

【原文 English Original】
In 2026, the United States went on an economic offensive looking to access critical minerals across Africa in its race to compete with China for materials that are essential for new technologies and the energy transformation. Will 2027 deliver on these promises for African governments and will the new Democrat-controlled US Congress complicate US deals with investigations into their transparency? – Investments or promises? – American companies and consortiums this year announced large-scale mining investment projects through partnerships in Guinea, South Africa, Mozambique and Kenya. But it was the strategic partnership agreed in December 2025 with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) that illustrated Washington’s economic push to secure its supply of critical minerals and reduce dependence on China. China has had a long head-start. It began investing in the African mining sector in the 1990s. The deal stipulated that Kinshasa would identify a portfolio of mining assets on which American investors have a right of first offer. In return, the Congolese government secured diplomatic support from Washington on security in its volatile eastern region, rocked by violence by myriad armed groups for more than 30 years. Since then, the American company Virtus Minerals, in partnership with the Indian group Lloyds Metals&Energy, has announced the acquisition of Chemaf, a heavily indebted Congolese company specialising in copper and cobalt. Orion Critical Mineral Consortium is negotiating with the international group Glencore for a 40-percent stake in its Mutanda and Kamoto mines, which also produce copper and cobalt. – Transparency probes? – Kinshasa urged Washington this month to “move from signed agreements to actual investments”. But the Democrats’ triumph in the US midterm elections could complicate the implementation of the partnerships concluded by the Trump administration amid questions about their transparency. The Democrats have already announced plans to open investigations early next year into the conditions under which the Trump administration conducted the negotiations. “Nothing should change in 2027 regarding the partnership principle, because the supply of minerals is of strategic national interest to the United States,” a mining source in the DRC told AFP. “The industry received bipartisan assurances on this issue in the run-up to the elections,” the source added. “But the agreements could be subject to opportunistic scrutiny by the Democrats, which might slow their implementation,” the source said. – Local economic benefits? – Several African countries have clearly demonstrated their determination to draw economic benefits from the partnerships. Zimbabwe suspended exports of raw minerals in February, ahead of a total ban in 2027, saying it would require processing and transformation to take place in the country. The ban prompted mining companies to rush to build lithium processing plants, the first step in the value chain. A first factory, built by a Chinese company, is now operational. Others are planned. The DRC, the world’s leading cobalt producer, has suspended exports of the metal needed for top-range batteries from next month. The measure, which aims to shore up prices by preventing an over-supply on the market, had already been applied in February 2025 before a quota policy was introduced. “Our country has for a long time contributed to the wealth of industries around the world without keeping a sufficient amount of the added value to ensure its own economic transition,” Congolese President Felix Tshisekedi told a business conference in Kinshasa this week. In remarks to companies and banks at the same forum, Mines Minister Louis Watum assured “those who will carry out processing on our soil will find a partner in the government”. – Banking on rail? – Interest in the continent’s mineral resources has led to the implementation and completion of several major infrastructure projects. The goal of schemes such as Guinea’s large-scale Simandou iron ore mining project or the Lobito Corridor between the DRC and Angola is to secure and speed up the transportation of minerals to port, often by rail. While some of the mining output from the southern DRC is still transported in a constant stream of trucks to South African ports, another part now goes by rail to the Angolan port of Lobito on the Atlantic coast. Zambia is also involved in the EU- and US-financed Lobito project. So far, it has been the missing link but progress is expected in 2027 on a railway line project connecting the copper-producing region in the north to the existing line in Angola. – High-risk? – In some African countries, US investors remain cautious and demand guarantees to secure their investments. Talks are under way between the United States and the DRC in particular to improve the business climate in a country perceived as risky due to endemic corruption, an unpredictable tax system and weak legal protection. “Kinshasa expects concrete investments in 2027. But major changes should not be expected too quickly because mining projects take time,” Jacques Mukena, of the Ebuteli institute, said. The eastern conflict pitting armed anti-governmental forces backed by Rwanda against the Congolese army also continues, despite several mediation efforts. “Without progress on security, investors will remain cautious,” Mukena said. # 尼泊尔启动程序将宣布8月洪灾中失踪的人员死亡

在边境地区发生自然灾难三个月后，尼泊尔政府周四宣布，已开始启动程序，将依法宣布今夏灾难性洪灾后仍失踪的数千人死亡。

[将 RFI 添加到 Google 收藏夹中 以便在搜索结果中优先显示 RFI 的内容。](https://rfi.my/GDcn)

发表时间： 26/11/2026 - 12:10

 4 分钟 浏览时间

 2026年9月10日，尼泊尔安全部队成员将洪灾中遇难者的遗体进行掩埋。 © Tyrone Siu / Reuters

 作者： [艾娃](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85/%E8%89%BE%E5%A8%83/ "艾娃")

广告

继续浏览后续

8月26日，位于尼泊尔与中国边境的一处高海拔冰川崩塌，引发夹杂了冰块、岩石和碎屑组成的洪流。 在尼泊尔境内，洪灾造成1400多人死亡，5500多人失踪。

尼泊尔灾害管理署发言人拉姆·巴哈杜尔·KC向法新社表示：“已通过核实相关细节，启动了将失踪人员宣告死亡的程序，”

尼泊尔当局已经发布公告，列出了约4,000名失踪人员名单，其中包括623名外国公民，并要求在正式宣布死亡前提出异议或更正。 经进一步核实后，名单中可能会增补更多的姓名；预计尼泊尔政府将在法律程序完成后发布死亡宣告。

此举源于尼泊尔上月对相关法律的修订，将宣布灾难遇难者死亡的等待期从12年缩短至约六周。

法新社指出，此次洪灾是这个喜马拉雅国家历史上最致命的灾难之一。

尽管数百名救援人员在泥浆和瓦砾堆中进行了数周的搜救，但仅发现极少数生还的失踪者。

迄今为止，仅有112具遗体被确认身份并交还给家属。

由于缺乏死亡证明，许多家庭无法申请领取赔偿、办理财产过户或其他法律事务。 一些家庭甚至已经为始终未能寻找到遗体的亲人举行了象征性的火化仪式。

在中国，据官方媒体9月份的报道，边境洪灾西藏一侧有43人遇难、519人失踪，并表示情况“仍在进一步调查中”。

此后，北京方面就再未提供任何最新进展，当法新社周四就此进行询问时，中国外交部发言人建议记者向有关的“主管部门”进行咨询。

# 美芯片、算力等限制及对蒸馏防范加强迫使中国AI模型发展放缓

据路透社援引知情人士报导，中国人工智能公司智谱AI（Z.AI ）的下一代旗舰模型开发进度已落后于原定计划；与此同时，竞争对手月之暗面（Moonshot AI）则预计，如果无法继续获取海外算力资源，其重大模型版本的发布间隔可能会从六个月延长至一年甚至更久。

发表时间： 26/11/2026 - 11:46 更改时间： 26/11/2026 - 12:22

 14 分钟 浏览时间

 2023年7月，在上海举行的世界人工智能大会上，一名工作人员正在检查中国超级计算机制造商展位上的显示屏，屏幕上展示着一枚计算机芯片以及“自主”二字。 © 美联社图片

 作者： [弗林](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85/%E5%BC%97%E6%9E%97/ "弗林")

广告

继续浏览后续

报导称，这些此前未被披露的细节显示，美国人工智能公司OpenAI和Anthropic所采取的防范蒸馏——即利用能力更强的模型所生成的答案来训练其他模型——的措施，已在一定程度上拖慢了中国人工智能的发展进程。而华盛顿方面最新实施的芯片限制措施，则可能导致进一步的延误。

这些限制措施危及了中国人工智能公司的一项核心优势——即在美方多年出口管制下，依然能够以显著更低的成本开发出具有竞争力的模型，并借此挑战美国竞争对手。

美国商务部于11月19日生效的一项规定实施了许可要求，旨在限制中国公司通过海外数据中心获取由美国先进芯片所提供的大规模算力；此举针对的是一种无需直接进口英伟达处理器即可使用其先进算力资源的方式。

两位知情人士透露称，智谱AI原计划于本月发布其下一代旗舰模型GLM-5.5，但目前尚未发布。其中一位知情人士称，该模型的模型参数约为3万亿个——这反映了其规模之大——其发布的延迟部分是因为受限于针对蒸馏日益有效的防范措施。

该人士称，智谱AI原本希望在今年年底前完成训练并发布该模型，但美国新出台的算力限制措施可能会导致其发布时间推迟至2027年第一季度或更晚。智谱AI未立即回应置评请求。

周一，智谱AI发布了GLM-5.4，该模型基于一个现有的、拥有7500亿参数的模型构建而成。智谱AI表示，得益于全新的设计，该模型能够达到与参数量在2万亿至3万亿参数规模的模型相当的性能水平。

Anthropic在9月份表示，已监测到其Claude模型与近2亿次疑似蒸馏活动的交互，并将这些活动归因于包括阿里巴巴、月之暗面和智谱AI在内的中国开发者。

OpenAI也曾针对与月之暗面相关的个人提出过类似的指控。Anthropic曾阐述其用于检测并阻止未经授权蒸馏行为的措施；OpenAI也表示已采取行动，旨在干扰此类活动。

月之暗面未能立即回应置评请求。此前，针对有关其Kimi K3模型性能是通过蒸馏方式实现的说法，月之暗面企业业务负责人黄震昕予以否认。据《每日经济新闻》7月22日报道，黄震昕表示：“Kimi K3性能实现跨越式提升，核心依托底层原创架构创新，并非对任何现有模型进行蒸馏复刻”。

据一位了解月之暗面运营情况的人士透露，由于该公司通过租用算力来训练模型，且倾向于选择海外服务商，因此月之暗面受美国新规的影响尤为严重。

该人士称，月之暗面内部预计，如果其获取海外算力的渠道被彻底切断，原本每六个月进行一次重大版本更新的节奏可能会延长至12个月甚至更久；此外，中国国内现有的算力资源也无法填补这一缺口。

该人士估计，月之暗面的下一代旗舰模型Kimi K4可能会推迟至2027年年中左右发布。此前，月之暗面曾于2025年7月发布Kimi K2，随后在今年1月发布K2.5，并在7月发布K3。

另一位人士说，月之暗面已加大在欧洲租用算力的力度，这证实了此前CNBC的相关报道。

据消费者新闻与商业频道（CNBC）月初报导，在白宫官员指控月之暗面通过东亚地区远程使用英伟达先进芯片后，月之暗面已试图通过位于欧洲的数据中心获取这些芯片的使用权。

四位知情人士称，今年曾就月之暗面从新云（neoclouds）处租用它们位于欧洲的设施中搭载的英伟达图形处理单元（GPU）算力一事进行过磋商。所谓新云是一类专注于为人工智能工作负载提供高性能GPU算力租赁服务的新型云计算服务商。三位消息人士称，月之暗面正寻求租赁基于英伟达Blackwell系统的算力。

路透社援引的知情人士补充称，月之暗面计划与中国芯片制造商接洽，探讨使用其处理器进行模型训练的可能性。

该人士还提到，针对蒸馏所采取的防范措施，也拖慢了月之暗面的开发进度。由于从Anthropic和OpenAI的模型中获取训练数据变得愈发困难，月之暗面已开始转向从谷歌和Meta开发的模型中进行蒸馏；这两家公司近期发布的新模型，已成为具有吸引力的训练数据来源。谷歌和Meta暂未立即回应置评请求。

美国针对海外数据中心出台了新限制措施。该规定适用于美国境外数据中心的计算设施，其规模需超过一个阈值——该阈值大致相当于750枚英伟达H100芯片，自2022年起，向中国出口此类芯片需获得美国出口许可证。

在新规生效前已在提供相关计算服务的运营方，有90天的时间来获取许可。新规还针对向马来西亚、新加坡、印尼、泰国和巴西出口先进芯片——包括H100芯片——的行为引入了许可要求，但符合条件的美国公司可获得豁免。

据英国《金融时报》周四报导，英伟达还已通知其制造合作伙伴，停止向上述四个东南亚国家运送服务器。英伟达未立即回应置评请求。

科技媒体《信息报》上周报导称，月之暗面已取消了一项价值1.5亿美元的交易；该交易原计划通过印尼的一家数据中心，获取英伟达先进的Blackwell人工智能芯片。Blackwell目前受美方出口管制，被禁止直接出口至中国。月之暗面拒绝就此向《信息报》置评。

content: 文章来源：纽约时报 作者：袁莉 Dongyan Xu 中国网络上最近流传着一个新笑话。 经济学家长期以来一直说，中国经济增长有三大引擎：投资、消费和出口。这个笑话说，新引擎是查官员的家、让富人补缴税款，以及向穷人征收社保。 政府需要资金来支持其迅速老龄化的人口，并投入巨资发展人工智能。但经济正处于低迷状态。结果是：随着北京为了支付各项开支进一步向民众的钱包伸手，无论贫富，中国民众都感到生活压力增加。 27岁的自由插画师和平面设计师哈德森·周（音）居住在西南部的贵州省，随着人工智能取代了人工设计，其工作逐渐减少。周（使用代词they/them）截至10月底今年的收入仅约3万元，大约是2025年的一半，但今年需向政府养老金计划缴纳的金额却更多。 哈德森·周的养老金账单——约1万元——比去年更高，因为该省提高了像周这样的零工经济从业者的最低缴费标准。 中国经济陷入低迷，房地产市场崩盘导致地方政府土地出让收入锐减，加深了地方政府债务问题。 劳动者和雇主向中国的养老基金缴费，但这些基金由地方政府管理，且地方政府分担部分费用。由于资金紧张，一些地方政府从养老基金中挪用了资金。在2025年6月发布的一份报告中，国家审计署表示，13个省份挪用了约406亿元的养老基金，用于支付政府工资和偿还债务。 与此同时，由于人口老龄化，养老金体系正承受压力。去年中国仅有790万新生儿出生，大约是2000年代和2010年代平均水平的一半。 北京目前也有理由鼓励人们向国家养老金体系缴纳更多资金。如果人们相信他们在退休后能够有所依靠，他们可能会减少储蓄，将钱花在当下，从而提振疲软的经济。 斯坦福大学经济学家许成钢认为，政府全力以赴收取更多社会保险的做法适得其反。“经济的根本问题是内需不足，”他说。“现在政府却挤压普通人来填补其财政缺口，这反而使得需求更加疲软。” 去年，中国最高人民法院规定，雇主必须为员工缴纳社会保险费，其中包括养老金、医疗保健和失业保险。长期以来，企业一直被要求向该系统缴费，并像在美国一样从员工工资中自动扣除相关款项，但这项法律并非总能得到执行。最高人民法院的这一决定遭到了小企业主的抵制，他们表示自己负担不起这些费用，同时也遭到了员工的怀疑，他们担心自己永远也领不到这笔钱。 今年，中国政府将注意力转向了零工经济从业者，据一家研究中心估计，零工人数约为3.2亿，占全国劳动力的40%以上。根据一份政府报告，截至2024年底，他们当中只有约7000万人参加了基本养老保险。 零工经济在中国被称为灵活就业，从业者需自行缴纳社会保障。政府要求他们按与省级平均工资挂钩的基数收入缴纳20%的社保。该平均工资通常远高于零工从业者的实际收入，而且每年都在上涨。 面对经济低迷，北京正不断向民众索取，以支持中国迅速老龄化的人口。  Qilai Shen for The New York Times 为了让人们缴费参保，地方官员们既尝试过劝说，也采取过强制手段。在湖北省中部的宜昌市，当局在10月举办了一场街头节庆活动，现场有跳舞的机器人、身着戏服的历史人物，以及穿着相应马甲的社会保障规划人员。在有些地方，政府引导人们通过举债来参与养老金保险。几个省份的银行与当地社保局合作，为零工提供贷款，以便他们能继续向养老金基金缴费，而债务将从其未来的养老金中扣除。一些城市还允许居民使用消费者信贷平台花呗进行支付。 更为令人不安的是，政府还承诺将利用数据挖掘来追踪未缴费人员。北京提出的参保“不漏一人”的口号，与新冠清零时期的隔离“不漏一人”如出一辙。 “这些人到底在哪儿？”人力资源和社会保障部副部长李忠上个月在一次新闻发布会上问道，他指的是那些没有缴费的人。“还是要通过各种各样的方式把人找到。” 这些做法在社交媒体上引发了广泛批评。一个关于年轻人为何放弃参保的话题标签，在社交媒体平台微博上获得了至少4800万次浏览量，随后该话题在搜索中被屏蔽。 中国政府迫切需要补充其养老基金，专家表示该基金可能会在2035年耗尽。政府一直在提高退休年龄和缴费水平，但在解决不平等方面进展缓慢：退休政府工作人员领取的养老金几乎是私营部门退休人员平均水平的两倍，是农村养老金领取者收入的30多倍。 对于视觉艺术家哈德森·周来说，向养老基金和医疗保险的缴费将达到每月约1400元，占其每月约3000元工资的46%。 哈德森·周决定和越来越多的中国人一样，不再向养老金系统缴费，这意味着退休后将无法领取养老金。 现在让哈德森·周更担心的是居委会，这个在基层充当政府耳目的机构。 2022年，居委会在微信群里反复@哈德森·周，呼吁哈德森·周和其他居民参加医疗保险。居委会的工作人员打电话给哈德森·周的母亲，敦促哈德森·周参保。国有无线运营商中国移动也发送了自动提醒。 中国政府还有其他方式强制缴费。在一些最大的城市，没有当地户口的居民如果没有缴费记录，就不能买房买车，其子女也不能进入公立学校就读。 在四川省工作的24岁实习律师王女士（音）却没有退出的选择。（由于害怕政府的报复，她要求只透露自己的姓氏。） 她每月的收入约为3000元，并表示为了获得必要的见习证书，必须出示律所为她缴纳社会保险的证明。社会保险抽走了她六分之一的工资。她自己宁愿不缴费，部分原因是费用太高，部分原因是她怀疑等她老了的时候，这个养老金体系是否还会存在。 一些富有的中国企业家表示，他们感觉自己就像一块肥肉，政府饿了就会来啃上一口。近年来，甚至地方警察也对企业下手，有时甚至捏造罪名，以此为债务缠身的地方政府榨取资金。 今年7月，北京发布了一项新规定，要求富有的中国人对其在离岸信托中持有的资产纳税。比尔是一位我认识十多年的企业家，他预计自己需缴纳数千万美元的税款。 在东京市中心一家可俯瞰皇居的餐厅吃早餐时，比尔（因担心政府报复，他要求仅使用英文名字）描述了自己的困惑和无奈。 他在香港生活了十多年，持有香港护照，并表示他已经在那里纳税多年。他说，根据新规定，这些可能都不重要了。 他担心，一旦缴纳税款，就等于承认了中国的税务居民身份，从而使他在中国境外的收入和投资日后也可能被征税。 “生在中国已经成了原罪，”他说。

title: 宏福苑大火一周年：居民受压、媒体噤声，为何悼念变得小心翼翼？

content: 郑佩珊 Role,BBC中文记者 李国鸿决定一个人回去。 一年前，香港大埔宏福苑大火夺走了他的母亲，家中两名外佣也不幸罹难。一周年将至，街坊之间曾谈论要否相约前往悼念，但在绷紧的社会气氛下，李国鸿选择独自回到屋苑附近。 “不需要约，约什么呢？他一会儿说你‘集会’。你不要让他捉到痛脚。我没有约定谁、何时回去。”他向BBC中文说。 压力不只落在遗属身上。香港政府强调“只要不违法”，传媒无受限制。然而，有电视台编采人员透露，有制作完成的周年专题在原定播放前被抽起，另有电视台高层曾指示报导要避免采访“人”。 这场大火去年造成168人死亡、79人受伤，1984户居民失去家园。遗属的声音能否被听见？市民可否集体悼念？对于会否举行官方悼念活动，政府一直未有明确表态。 至周年两日前（周二），政务司司长陈国基表示，坊间已有悼念活动，政府不会举办官方活动，亦不会妨碍巿民参与合法悼念，又指留意网上有人呼吁藉机破坏，提醒市民小心选择活动；若有破坏，政府会执法。 BBC中文梳理大火发生至周年前夕的社会氛围，遗属与居民如何承受压力，在前线记录的新闻工作者又如何经历言论空间的改变。 周年前夕的“不可预期因素” 李国鸿说只会独自回到屋苑附近悼念。 踏入11月，一些宏福苑居民向BBC中文表示，他们开始感觉到氛围不一样了。 有居民表示，怀疑自己遭人跟踪，因此要求记者删除早前受访时评论政府灾后安排的内容；另有居民称，出入时曾被不明人士尾随或拍摄；有民间人士向BBC中文称曾被劝喻避免评论宏福苑事宜。BBC中文未能独立核实相关事件，亦无法确认涉事者身份及动机。 与此同时，宗教团体的悼念活动亦现波澜。 大埔圣母无玷之心堂在11月15日举行弥撒，曾一度更换主题抽走宏福苑字眼，并删除宣传帖文，最终决定以“为悼念2026年亡者暨宏福苑火灾周年祈祷”为主题。 负责主持的罗马天主教香港教区夏志诚辅理主教称，帖文下架属“误会”，并确认警方曾向堂区查询。 湾仔圣母圣衣堂主任司铎罗国辉 向传媒表示 ，有自称警察的“朋友”到教堂“关心”弥撒详情； 他认为 执法部门今次对宗教活动的关心“太过扰民”，应要反思为何悼念亡者都觉得不平安。 天主教香港教区周守仁枢机主教则去信各堂区，吁请在火灾一周年当日“为大埔宏福苑的亡者奉献弥撒”。 警务处处长周一鸣曾 回应事件 称，警方一向有责任向主办单位了解公众活动，最终是否举办，则要向主办单位查询。 与宏福苑相关的活动亦见告吹。 大火期间，10名外籍佣工罹难；关注外佣平台Microlab Collective原定11月22日在香港理工大学举行活动，由幸存外佣分享灾后创伤及互助历程；主办单位突然 宣布 因“不可预期因素（unforeseen circumstances）”需要临时停办。 大埔圣母无玷之心堂一度更换悼念弥撒主题，抽走宏福苑字眼。香港教区辅理主教夏志诚在“宏福苑火灾周年”的主题下主持弥撒。 去年 大火发生后 ，大批市民自发于邻近屋苑的广福休憩处献花悼念，有义工设留言区提供纸条供人抒发感受，其后 自行撤离 ；政府建筑物则连续三天下半旗、官员默哀，亦在各区设置弔唁处。 悲剧即将踏入一周年，公务员事务局局长杨何蓓茵在11月20日 发文称 ，早前到浩园悼念殉职消防员何伟豪。 不过，政府早前一直未表态会否有官方悼念活动，至周年两日前才明确表明不会组织官方活动。 《信报》日前报导 ，政府及建制阵营倾向不举悼念活动，并引述建制中人指，哀悼人潮或成巿民对处理火灾表现的指标；政商界人士和意见领袖 被“劝喻” 不要出席悼念宏福苑的活动。 此前，政务司司长陈国基在11月20日 表示 ，天主教、基督教及佛教是“正当”团体，巿民可安心参与相应的悼念活动，又指网上有别有用人士利用悼念做破坏行为，警方会依法处理。 11月21日，有人于 社交媒体称 广福休憩处中央被人划下黄黑线，引述康文署职员称线内区域将开放予市民献花追思。BBC中文向港府查询，是否由政府部门划线、周年当日有何安排；政府发言人回覆没有确认安排，称“任何活动如不违反法律，都可进行”。 保安局长邓炳强其后现身记者会，也没有直接回应会否有安排，称“任何合法活动都会容许”，提醒悼念之余，要留意是否有人煽动参与违法行为。 宏福苑大火夺走168条人命。 妻子在大火丧生的叶家驹向BBC中文表示，他打算在大火一周年当天回到现场悼念，“但不会跟人说几点钟”，又指希望关心宏福苑、想要悼念的人士不一定要回到宏福苑。 他解释，担心人们聚集会招来话柄，被指控“趁机搞事”，悼念空间或进一步被扼杀。 “很自私地去想，我不想在这一天有任何不愉快事件发生，不希望有任何冲突。希望能够一个宁静的空间给我们，在这里悼念我们离开了的家人。” 提及政府部门划线悼念的网络帖文称“欢迎转载分享”，叶家驹亦质疑发帖者身份及目的，“他想造就一个怎样的效果，需要想深一层。” 在大火中痛失爱妻的叶家驹不时重回宏福苑，他说理解居民面对的压力，也曾调整自己的表达方式。 受访灾民——从露面到匿名 叶家驹说，理解居民一直面对压力，担心“被算帐”而不愿公开发声。在他看来，这种气氛与火灾发生后的官方言论也有关系。 中国政府驻港国家安全公署曾称， 支持香港特区打击“以灾乱港”行径 ；近日中国国务院港澳办 回应政府问责措施的评论文章 亦再度提及“以灾乱港”论调。 据报，曾就火灾发起联署的大学生关靖丰，去年11月29日被香港警察国安处拘捕；曾希望探讨政府监管等议题的民间记者会称“因有部门通知”需要取消。 香港警方向BBC中文称，任何拘捕和检控按法律进行，又指“没有任何人因关注宏福苑事件被捕。” 居民的另一种压力是源于无力感。 今年1月，政府收集受影响业主对长远居住安排的意见，发出问卷翌日，财政司副司长黄伟纶已明言，宏福苑日后不会兴建住宅，改为社区设施较恰当，强调不会让人以该土地图利，并指程序繁复，原址重建“不切实际”。 曾有业主代表向立法会递交联署坚持原址重建。 何佩珊在单位内张贴“我爱宏福”的标贴。 2月，政府提出收购业权，居民可选择收取现金或选购其他房屋项目，须于8月底前表态，当中并无原址重建选项。 黄伟纶称 ，在有回应的1900多户之中，仅9%“只接受原址重建”；同时有22%对原址重建及其他方案均会考虑，即共31%曾表达冀原址重建。 后来，居民获安排在限时内上楼执拾，有人曾在窗前展示或贴上“原址重建”等标语，亦被要求移除。 叶家驹觉得，政府很快已对原址重建“落闸”，“无论我们讲什么，它都不听的，它只是一意孤行。” 他质疑，政府希望尽快清拆屋苑令事件“完结”。他形容，这八座大厦犹如政府眼中的“耻辱柱”，“因为放在这里，就是不停提醒大家，究竟这个政府有多不堪。” 中国当局反复强调“以灾乱港”的论调，香港特区政务司司长陈国基另呼吁香港市民小心选择悼念活动。 此外，有受访居民表示，宏福苑业主立案法团前管委会成员江祥发被捕后，他们对公开表达意见变得更加谨慎。 原法团管委会在火灾后被解散，政府委任合安管理公司为管理人。有居民试图召开业主大会，商讨屋苑保险及工程等跟进事项。4月，江祥发连同其他业主递交联署要求开会。 然而，江祥发与妻子在5月被捕，两人被指涉嫌骗取政府贷款，后被控诈骗及洗黑钱。获准保释候查期间，江祥发表明不再受访，亦不再回应或评论任何事件。 目前案件已在法院提讯，案情与宏福苑大火及其后的业主诉求并无已知直接关联。 对一些居民而言，案件已衍生寒蝉效应。 叶家驹说，有一段日子“没怎么说话”，现在转向一种避开触碰红线的表达方式。 自小在宏福苑长大的阿安（化名），曾经在镜头前实名露面受访，江祥发案立案后，她会视乎访问内容，要求匿名及戴上口罩，也试过在出席独立委员会听证会时被家人拉走避开记者。她说，“真的不知道你究竟踩了甚么，而令到被盯上”，变相“不敢去做头或发号施令去做一些事情”。 据BBC中文了解，有居民近来受访，表明只谈感受和个人生活，不愿触及政府措施。 “条气唔顺”：坚持不卖业权的人 目前仍有13户表明不接受收购方案。政府表示很可能透过立法强制收回余下业权。 何佩珊是其中一人，她早年已独力完成按揭，母亲属挂名业主。 她向BBC表示，自己过往不理会政治，去年3月退休，生活无大负担，她仅需照顾在老人院的母亲，闲时安排旅行。大火当日凌晨，她才刚返回香港，最终在睡梦中逃离火场，身后的玩具及黑胶唱片则在高温下溶化变形。 何佩珊现居大埔区内的过渡性房屋，可在窗外眺望宏福苑，出入不时也会为旧居拍照留念。 但她觉得，现址并不是家，胶箱、纸箱堆叠也没意欲执拾，平日也不欲煮食，如今还不时失眠，皮肤出疹。 她频频受访解释自己的决定，也说“若我还上班，我都应该不说那么多”。 何佩珊拒绝收购，主要在于“条气唔顺”（嚥不下这口气）。她形容官方态度强硬，程序不透明、不公道，质疑在未有验楼报告下，便提出收购业权方案，居民卖业权要一并把屋苑火险索偿权同时转让给政府。 前香港特区运输及房屋局局长张炳良撰文称 ，立法“强购”易招政府开剥夺私产先例的疑虑，呼吁当局尽早公布验楼报告，令居民释疑。房屋局向BBC中文称，验楼报告仍未完成，可能牵涉未来与保险公司商讨火险索偿，现阶段不宜公开，惟没有回应政府会否将日后所得的赔偿归还至原业主。 何佩珊觉得，有人或形容她的决定太傻，也曾有不认识的人在街头向她道谢。“我发声不是想全世界的人觉得我好勇，去拿个威风，我说我只不过觉得不公，我要去做。” 何佩珊出入会途经宏福苑，她不时为旧居拍照留念。 欧太育有三子，曾考虑如何告知拒绝出售业权的决定，也挣扎怎样发声。 拒绝出售业权还有欧氏一家，夫妇育有三名儿子，与外佣同住。 欧太太形容，其宏福苑的单位为“total loss”（全损报废）。当日夫妇上楼，在单位内以油漆喷上“人在家在”，从火场捡回的物品，部分存放于迷你仓，但一个被烧得发黑的夹万（保险柜）至今仍放在现居单位的睡房。她说：“这是唯一与宏福苑的联系。” 各人至今定期接受临床心理学家辅导，儿子发恶梦，早前还拒绝在新居安装明火炉具，“他们觉得在屋内用火是危险的。” 欧太在意政府的程序和态度，她称官员一方面形容收购方案“你情我愿”，另一方面又扬言或立法处理，感觉备受恐吓；加上独立委员会揭露政府部门缺失、维修工程充满漏洞，“在这么多不公不平的情况之下，我真的不愿意出售我的宏福苑。” 她纠结一番，才向儿子透露不卖业权的决定，考量怎样解释为何不是“少数服从多数”及实际居住问题。她持续发声的同时，也会反思“为何你作为一个妈妈，你还走出来？你有没有保护你的小朋友？” 曾经担任法团管委员成员，欧太说，她不会做什么行动，只会在感觉安全的范围内尽量表达心声，她需要真相和公道，“香港第一次真的好像灭村一样，整个屋苑变成死城。” 消失的声音：专题报导被抽起 有居民的情绪至今受困扰。 住了三十多年的梁女士哽咽道，“有时我看Facebook，就忍不住眼泪”，所以也没有出席听证会。她感激挺身而出的人，同时叹息“有认识的街坊对政府处理手法不满，但我们真的是人微言轻，根本没有这个能力，现在只是任它安排。” 遗属李国鸿长期跟进屋苑的维修工程问题，曾向不同机构投诉，还在独立委员会担任涉事方及证人，提交闭路电视片段，显示浓烟如何在短时间内攻入单位。母亲及外佣丧生，他深夜不时回想火灾一刻，“如果代入，当时我也在，又会怎样？” 李国鸿希望，有更多人站出来对事件发声，“如果你来来去去都是我们几个，人家就觉得只有我们在搞事。” “谁帮我们？除了记者。有些问题是记者问，我们也问不到。” 然而，BBC中文接触多名在不同传媒机构的新闻工作者，他们要求匿名受访，并描述过去一年处理宏福苑新闻曾遭受的压力。 有电视台编采人员说，高层认为官方已定性宏福苑事件带“国安风险”，部分稿件须直接交给高层审视，报导可探讨制度，但要避免采访“人”，“觉得控制不了他们的嘴巴，很多时候会怕他们说很多反政府的话”，另有已约定的周年专题访问被取消。 在另一间电视台工作的人员称，内部曾要求减少使用悼念献花的画面。据知，有制作完成的周年专题在原定播放前“被抽起”，编采人员事前曾按照高层指示删除一些居民追责的“负面”内容，但报导最终还是遭雪藏。 有网媒记者亦称，其机构要求慎用或避用悼念场境张贴字句的相片，亦会调动刊登报导时间，避开太密集，减少“被问候”的风险。 有报章记者表示，“收电话指示”情况较往日频繁，探讨问责议题尤其困难，议员拒绝表态。另一报章记者称，当居民提出原址重建诉求，公司会要求涵盖另一方立场，但是“他支持政府的，我不用找反对政府的人来讲”。 香港政府一名发言人向BBC中文称，政府保障传媒采访与报道权利，“只要不违法，传媒评论和批评政府施政的自由并无受到限制”。 香港中文大学新闻与传播学院李立峰教授向BBC中文说，按其观察，宏福苑相对过往的灾难新闻，批评或问责声音较少，以往新闻机构会主动发掘民众声音、专家意见或其他线索，但目前主要依赖报导听证会的发现或上楼执拾居民的行动，属于“被动式”报导。 李立峰指出，报导手法不只是机构内部问题，社会氛围亦有影响，“就算媒体愿意去做这些新闻，容不容易找到相应的人去讲这些事？” 他分析，一般而言，影像的传播感染力会高于文字；而政府近年关注国家安全，在政府角度，或不太希望一些新闻容易连结过去大型社会运动的状态，如它可能觉得悼念会否联结至六四烛光晚会，写字句张贴会否联想到“连侬墙”；若传媒要自我审查，便会先处理某些“敏感”影像。 他又指，政府可能觉得灾难容易牵动巿民情绪，会特别顾忌任何可能触发到集体行动的事，包括原址重建议题。 宏福苑大火后，民众于屋苑外献花并留下字条。 “我回去是天经地义” 遗属叶家驹说，街坊陆续开展新生活，“未必愿意回头望”，即使港人未必忘记事件，但热度会减退。他持续受访留下纪录，同时带着伤痛走下去。 他未梦见太太，因此感到不开心，曾以AI制作动画模拟二人重聚场境。 “有朝一日如果我真在某处见到我老婆，我可以很挺起胸膛跟她讲：‘老婆，我做了我要做的事’。” 欧太忙着为儿子备考，“趁现在还能说”便接受多个访问。儿子不时嚷着大火周年要回到宏福苑，她还在挣扎。 阿安则说早已安排请假。“悼念这件事，我倒也没什么犹豫。” “这一天，我回去是天经地义。不让我回去，不是吧？”
